{"parentUuid":"222f0326-e6a9-4c1a-a361-063398509554","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_pirmmoaew6ky1vbxb6ukdh7b","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/PlanBuilder.java","content":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.HashSet;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\nimport java.util.Set;\n\n/**\n * 把请求 JSON 解析并校验为 {@link QueryPlan}。\n *\n * 校验内容：表存在且列等长；过滤中引用的列存在、比较类型匹配（int/string、\n * 字面量可为 null 但仅 = / !=）；Union 只能位于根；投影 / 聚合 / 分组列存在；\n * 聚合函数合法且类型匹配；显式 selection 的下标合法；batchSize &gt;= 1。\n */\npublic final class PlanBuilder {\n\n    private final Catalog catalog;\n\n    public PlanBuilder(Catalog catalog) {\n        this.catalog = catalog;\n    }\n\n    public QueryPlan build(Object requestObj) {\n        Map<String, Object> req = Json.asMap(requestObj);\n\n        // 1) 表：目录名引用 或 内联表\n        Object tableObj = req.get(\"table\");\n        if (tableObj == null) throw new InvalidQueryException(\"请求缺少 table 字段\");\n        Table table;\n        if (tableObj instanceof String name) {\n            table = catalog.require(name);\n        } else {\n            table = Table.fromJson(tableObj);\n        }\n\n        int batchSize = parseBatchSize(req.get(\"batchSize\"));\n\n        // 2) 过滤\n        FilterExpr filter = req.containsKey(\"filter\") && req.get(\"filter\") != null\n                ? FilterExpr.fromJson(req.get(\"filter\"))\n                : null;\n        if (filter != null) {\n            validateFilter(filter, table, true);\n        }\n\n        // 3) 投影\n        List<String> projection = parseStringList(req.get(\"projection\"), \"projection\");\n\n        // 4) 聚合与分组\n        List<AggSpec> aggregates = new ArrayList<>();\n        if (req.containsKey(\"aggregates\") && req.get(\"aggregates\") != null) {\n            for (Object a : Json.asList(req.get(\"aggregates\"))) {\n                aggregates.add(AggSpec.fromJson(a));\n            }\n        }\n        List<String> groupBy = parseStringList(req.get(\"groupBy\"), \"groupBy\");\n        validateAggregates(aggregates, groupBy, table);\n        for (String g : groupBy) table.column(g); // 存在性检查\n\n        // 5) 显式输入选择向量\n        SelectionVector selection = null;\n        if (req.containsKey(\"selection\") && req.get(\"selection\") != null) {\n            int[] raw = Column.parseIntRows(req.get(\"selection\"), \"selection\");\n            selection = SelectionVector.wrapSorted(table.rowCount(), raw);\n        }\n\n        // 6) 导出目录\n        Object ed = req.get(\"exportDir\");\n        String exportDir = ed == null ? null : String.valueOf(ed);\n\n        return new QueryPlan(table, filter, projection, aggregates, groupBy,\n                batchSize, selection, exportDir);\n    }\n\n    private int parseBatchSize(Object o) {\n        if (o == null) return QueryPlan.DEFAULT_BATCH_SIZE;\n        if (!(o instanceof Number n)) {\n            throw new InvalidQueryException(\"batchSize 必须是正整数，实际为 \" + Json.typeName(o));\n        }\n        int bs = n.intValue();\n        if (bs < 1) throw new InvalidQueryException(\"batchSize 必须 >= 1，实际为 \" + bs);\n        return bs;\n    }\n\n    private List<String> parseStringList(Object o, String field) {\n        if (o == null) return List.of();\n        List<Object> list = Json.asList(o);\n        List<String> out = new ArrayList<>();\n        Set<String> seen = new HashSet<>();\n        for (Object e : list) {\n            if (!(e instanceof String s) || s.isEmpty()) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(field + \" 必须由非空字符串组成\");\n            }\n            if (!seen.add(s)) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(field + \" 中列 \\\"\" + s + \"\\\" 重复出现\");\n            }\n            out.add(s);\n        }\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 过滤校验 ----------------\n\n    private void validateFilter(FilterExpr f, Table t, boolean atRoot) {\n        switch (f) {\n            case FilterExpr.Union u -> {\n                if (!atRoot) {\n                    throw new InvalidQueryException(\n                            \"union（分支结果合并）只能作为过滤计划的根节点，不能嵌在 and/or/not 内部\");\n                }\n                for (FilterExpr b : u.branches()) {\n                    validateFilter(b, t, false);\n                    if (b instanceof FilterExpr.Union) {\n                        throw new InvalidQueryException(\"union 的分支不能再嵌套 union\");\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.And and -> {\n                for (FilterExpr c : and.children()) validateFilter(c, t, false);\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Or or -> {\n                for (FilterExpr c : or.children()) validateFilter(c, t, false);\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Not n -> validateFilter(n.child(), t, false);\n            case FilterExpr.IsNull isn -> requireColumn(t, isn.column());\n            case FilterExpr.Compare cmp -> validateCompare(t, cmp);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private Column requireColumn(Table t, String name) {\n        try {\n            return t.column(name);\n        } catch (InvalidQueryException e) {\n            throw e;\n        }\n    }\n\n    private void validateCompare(Table t, FilterExpr.Compare cmp) {\n        Column c = t.column(cmp.column());\n        String op = cmp.op();\n        switch (op) {\n            case \"=\", \"==\", \"!=\", \"<>\", \"<\", \"<=\", \">\", \">=\" -> { }\n            default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\n                    \"不支持的比较算子 \\\"\" + op + \"\\\"（支持 = != < <= > >=）\");\n        }\n        Object v = cmp.value();\n        if (v == null) {\n            if (!op.equals(\"=\") && !op.equals(\"==\") && !op.equals(\"!=\") && !op.equals(\"<>\")) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"列 \" + cmp.column()\n                        + \" 与 NULL 只能做 = / != 比较（结果遵循三值逻辑；判空请用 isNull）\");\n            }\n            return; // NULL 字面量对两种列类型都合法\n        }\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn) {\n            if (!(v instanceof Number)) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"整型列 \" + cmp.column()\n                        + \" 不能与字符串字面量 \" + v + \" 比较\");\n            }\n            Column.toInt(v); // 范围检查\n        } else if (c instanceof StringColumn) {\n            if (!(v instanceof String)) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列 \" + cmp.column()\n                        + \" 只能与字符串字面量比较，实际为 \" + Json.typeName(v));\n            }\n            if (!op.equals(\"=\") && !op.equals(\"==\") && !op.equals(\"!=\") && !op.equals(\"<>\")) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列 \" + cmp.column()\n                        + \" 只支持 = / != 比较，实际为 \" + op);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 聚合校验 ----------------\n\n    private void validateAggregates(List<AggSpec> aggs, List<String> groupBy, Table t) {\n        Set<String> outNames = new HashSet<>();\n        for (AggSpec a : aggs) {\n            String fn = a.func().toLowerCase();\n            if (!fn.equals(\"count\") && !fn.equals(\"sum\") && !fn.equals(\"avg\")\n                    && !fn.equals(\"min\") && !fn.equals(\"max\")) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"不支持的聚合函数 \\\"\" + a.func()\n                        + \"\\\"（支持 count/sum/avg/min/max）\");\n            }\n            if (!a.isCountStar()) {\n                Column c = t.column(a.column());\n                if ((fn.equals(\"sum\") || fn.equals(\"avg\")) && !(c instanceof IntColumn)) {\n                    throw new InvalidQueryException(fn + \" 只能用于整型列，列 \" + a.column()\n                            + \" 是 \" + c.typeName() + \" 类型\");\n                }\n            }\n            if (!outNames.add(a.outputName())) {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"聚合输出名 \\\"\" + a.outputName() + \"\\\" 重复\");\n            }\n        }\n        if (!groupBy.isEmpty() && aggs.isEmpty()) {\n            throw new InvalidQueryException(\"指定了 groupBy 但没有任何聚合表达式\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_7f761c4fe183730e1ca1a2d8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":3144,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":49976,"output_tokens":2380,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_pirmmoaew6ky1vbxb6ukdh7b":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"3972ac9c-0224-4a93-99ee-0ec80f065f2b","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_edwao6svfl5234dbu2m5oo0l","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/VectorFilter.java","content":"package vecq;\n\n/**\n * 向量化过滤执行器：对“输入选择向量的一个批次”求三值状态，再压实（compact）出 TRUE 行。\n *\n * 处理模型：\n *   输入 SV（有序、可稀疏、可重复）\n *     -> 按 batchSize 切批\n *     -> 每批求出 byte[] 状态（0=FALSE,1=TRUE,2=UNKNOWN，见 {@link Tri}）\n *     -> 顺序压实 TRUE 的行下标到输出 SV\n *\n * 压实保持顺序，输入有序且分批顺序处理，所以输出仍然有序；重复下标只要状态为 TRUE\n * 就会被原样重复输出。\n */\npublic final class VectorFilter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public VectorFilter(Table table) {\n        this.table = table;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 对输入选择向量执行过滤。\n     * @return 过滤后的选择向量；同时通过 stats 回批数等统计\n     */\n    public SelectionVector apply(FilterExpr f, SelectionVector input, int batchSize, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (f instanceof FilterExpr.Union u) {\n            // 顶层 union：每个分支独立过滤，多重集并集（重复下标按次数累加）\n            SelectionVector merged = null;\n            for (FilterExpr branch : u.branches()) {\n                SelectionVector part = apply(branch, input, batchSize, stats);\n                merged = (merged == null) ? part : SelectionVector.union(merged, part);\n            }\n            return merged == null ? SelectionVector.empty(table.rowCount()) : merged;\n        }\n\n        int[] rows = input.toArray();\n        int n = rows.length;\n        int[] out = new int[Math.max(4, n)];\n        int outLen = 0;\n        int batches = 0;\n\n        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += batchSize) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(batchSize, n - start);\n            byte[] state = evalBatch(f, rows, start, len);\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                if (state[i] == Tri.TRUE) {\n                    if (outLen == out.length) out = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(out, out.length * 2);\n                    out[outLen++] = rows[start + i];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        stats.filterBatches += batches;\n        return SelectionVector.ofSorted(table.rowCount(), out, outLen);\n    }\n\n    /** 求一个批次的三值状态。 */\n    public byte[] evalBatch(FilterExpr f, int[] rows, int off, int len) {\n        byte[] state = new byte[len];\n        switch (f) {\n            case FilterExpr.Compare cmp -> evalCompare(cmp, rows, off, len, state);\n            case FilterExpr.IsNull isn -> {\n                Column c = table.column(isn.column());\n                boolean negate = isn.negate();\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    boolean isNull = c.isNull(rows[off + i]);\n                    state[i] = (isNull != negate) ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Not n -> {\n                byte[] child = evalBatch(n.child(), rows, off, len);\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.not(child[i]);\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.And and -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.TRUE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : and.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.and(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Or or -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.FALSE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : or.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.or(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Union u ->\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"union 不能在批次求值中出现（只允许位于根节点）\");\n        }\n        return state;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 比较 ----------------\n\n    private void evalCompare(FilterExpr.Compare cmp, int[] rows, int off, int len, byte[] state) {\n        Column c = table.column(cmp.column());\n        String op = normalize(cmp.op());\n        Object literal = cmp.value();\n\n        // 任何与 NULL 字面量的比较（= / !=）结果恒为 UNKNOWN —— 即使该行本身也是 NULL\n        if (literal == null) {\n            java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.UNKNOWN);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) {\n            int lit = Column.toInt(literal);\n            int[] data = rawInts(ic);\n            switch (op) {\n                case \"=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] == lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"!=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] != lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] < lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] <= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] > lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] >= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\"整型列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else if (c instanceof StringColumn sc) {\n            String lit = (String) literal;\n            if (op.equals(\"=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else if (op.equals(\"!=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(!lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else {\n            throw new InvalidQueryException(\"不支持的列类型: \" + c.typeName());\n        }\n    }\n\n    static String normalize(String op) {\n        return switch (op) {\n            case \"==\" -> \"=\";\n            case \"<>\" -> \"!=\";\n            default -> op;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static byte tri(boolean b) {\n        return b ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private static int[] rawInts(IntColumn ic) {\n        // IntColumn 内部就是 int[]，通过反射之外的包级访问避免拷贝：\n        return RawAccess.ints(ic);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_91a3689fab82ef231266a9ec","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2557,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":53048,"output_tokens":3808,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_edwao6svfl5234dbu2m5oo0l":{"content":"package vecq;\n\n/**\n * 向量化过滤执行器：对“输入选择向量的一个批次”求三值状态，再压实（compact）出 TRUE 行。\n *\n * 处理模型：\n *   输入 SV（有序、可稀疏、可重复）\n *     -> 按 batchSize 切批\n *     -> 每批求出 byte[] 状态（0=FALSE,1=TRUE,2=UNKNOWN，见 {@link Tri}）\n *     -> 顺序压实 TRUE 的行下标到输出 SV\n *\n * 压实保持顺序，输入有序且分批顺序处理，所以输出仍然有序；重复下标只要状态为 TRUE\n * 就会被原样重复输出。\n */\npublic final class VectorFilter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public VectorFilter(Table table) {\n        this.table = table;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 对输入选择向量执行过滤。\n     * @return 过滤后的选择向量；同时通过 stats 回批数等统计\n     */\n    public SelectionVector apply(FilterExpr f, SelectionVector input, int batchSize, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (f instanceof FilterExpr.Union u) {\n            // 顶层 union：每个分支独立过滤，多重集并集（重复下标按次数累加）\n            SelectionVector merged = null;\n            for (FilterExpr branch : u.branches()) {\n                SelectionVector part = apply(branch, input, batchSize, stats);\n                merged = (merged == null) ? part : SelectionVector.union(merged, part);\n            }\n            return merged == null ? SelectionVector.empty(table.rowCount()) : merged;\n        }\n\n        int[] rows = input.toArray();\n        int n = rows.length;\n        int[] out = new int[Math.max(4, n)];\n        int outLen = 0;\n        int batches = 0;\n\n        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += batchSize) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(batchSize, n - start);\n            byte[] state = evalBatch(f, rows, start, len);\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                if (state[i] == Tri.TRUE) {\n                    if (outLen == out.length) out = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(out, out.length * 2);\n                    out[outLen++] = rows[start + i];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        stats.filterBatches += batches;\n        return SelectionVector.ofSorted(table.rowCount(), out, outLen);\n    }\n\n    /** 求一个批次的三值状态。 */\n    public byte[] evalBatch(FilterExpr f, int[] rows, int off, int len) {\n        byte[] state = new byte[len];\n        switch (f) {\n            case FilterExpr.Compare cmp -> evalCompare(cmp, rows, off, len, state);\n            case FilterExpr.IsNull isn -> {\n                Column c = table.column(isn.column());\n                boolean negate = isn.negate();\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    boolean isNull = c.isNull(rows[off + i]);\n                    state[i] = (isNull != negate) ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Not n -> {\n                byte[] child = evalBatch(n.child(), rows, off, len);\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.not(child[i]);\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.And and -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.TRUE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : and.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.and(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Or or -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.FALSE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : or.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.or(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Union u ->\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"union 不能在批次求值中出现（只允许位于根节点）\");\n        }\n        return state;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 比较 ----------------\n\n    private void evalCompare(FilterExpr.Compare cmp, int[] rows, int off, int len, byte[] state) {\n        Column c = table.column(cmp.column());\n        String op = normalize(cmp.op());\n        Object literal = cmp.value();\n\n        // 任何与 NULL 字面量的比较（= / !=）结果恒为 UNKNOWN —— 即使该行本身也是 NULL\n        if (literal == null) {\n            java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.UNKNOWN);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) {\n            int lit = Column.toInt(literal);\n            int[] data = rawInts(ic);\n            switch (op) {\n                case \"=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] == lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"!=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] != lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] < lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] <= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] > lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] >= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\"整型列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else if (c instanceof StringColumn sc) {\n            String lit = (String) literal;\n            if (op.equals(\"=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else if (op.equals(\"!=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(!lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else {\n            throw new InvalidQueryException(\"不支持的列类型: \" + c.typeName());\n        }\n    }\n\n    static String normalize(String op) {\n        return switch (op) {\n            case \"==\" -> \"=\";\n            case \"<>\" -> \"!=\";\n            default -> op;\n        };\n    }\n\n    private static byte tri(boolean b) {\n        return b ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n    }\n\n    private static int[] rawInts(IntColumn ic) {\n        // IntColumn 内部就是 int[]，通过反射之外的包级访问避免拷贝：\n        return RawAccess.ints(ic);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7b39e272-e477-47e0-b136-664a9dfbed2c","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n    }\n}","originalFile":"package vecq;\n\n/**\n * 向量化过滤执行器：对“输入选择向量的一个批次”求三值状态，再压实（compact）出 TRUE 行。\n *\n * 处理模型：\n *   输入 SV（有序、可稀疏、可重复）\n *     -> 按 batchSize 切批\n *     -> 每批求出 byte[] 状态（0=FALSE,1=TRUE,2=UNKNOWN，见 {@link Tri}）\n *     -> 顺序压实 TRUE 的行下标到输出 SV\n *\n * 压实保持顺序，输入有序且分批顺序处理，所以输出仍然有序；重复下标只要状态为 TRUE\n * 就会被原样重复输出。\n */\npublic final class VectorFilter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public VectorFilter(Table table) {\n        this.table = table;\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * 对输入选择向量执行过滤。\n     * @return 过滤后的选择向量；同时通过 stats 回批数等统计\n     */\n    public SelectionVector apply(FilterExpr f, SelectionVector input, int batchSize, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (f instanceof FilterExpr.Union u) {\n            // 顶层 union：每个分支独立过滤，多重集并集（重复下标按次数累加）\n            SelectionVector merged = null;\n            for (FilterExpr branch : u.branches()) {\n                SelectionVector part = apply(branch, input, batchSize, stats);\n                merged = (merged == null) ? part : SelectionVector.union(merged, part);\n            }\n            return merged == null ? SelectionVector.empty(table.rowCount()) : merged;\n        }\n\n        int[] rows = input.toArray();\n        int n = rows.length;\n        int[] out = new int[Math.max(4, n)];\n        int outLen = 0;\n        int batches = 0;\n\n        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += batchSize) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(batchSize, n - start);\n            byte[] state = evalBatch(f, rows, start, len);\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                if (state[i] == Tri.TRUE) {\n                    if (outLen == out.length) out = java.util.Arrays.copyOf(out, out.length * 2);\n                    out[outLen++] = rows[start + i];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        stats.filterBatches += batches;\n        return SelectionVector.ofSorted(table.rowCount(), out, outLen);\n    }\n\n    /** 求一个批次的三值状态。 */\n    public byte[] evalBatch(FilterExpr f, int[] rows, int off, int len) {\n        byte[] state = new byte[len];\n        switch (f) {\n            case FilterExpr.Compare cmp -> evalCompare(cmp, rows, off, len, state);\n            case FilterExpr.IsNull isn -> {\n                Column c = table.column(isn.column());\n                boolean negate = isn.negate();\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    boolean isNull = c.isNull(rows[off + i]);\n                    state[i] = (isNull != negate) ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Not n -> {\n                byte[] child = evalBatch(n.child(), rows, off, len);\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.not(child[i]);\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.And and -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.TRUE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : and.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.and(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Or or -> {\n                java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.FALSE);\n                for (FilterExpr child : or.children()) {\n                    byte[] cs = evalBatch(child, rows, off, len);\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) state[i] = Tri.or(state[i], cs[i]);\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Union u ->\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"union 不能在批次求值中出现（只允许位于根节点）\");\n        }\n        return state;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 比较 ----------------\n\n    private void evalCompare(FilterExpr.Compare cmp, int[] rows, int off, int len, byte[] state) {\n        Column c = table.column(cmp.column());\n        String op = normalize(cmp.op());\n        Object literal = cmp.value();\n\n        // 任何与 NULL 字面量的比较（= / !=）结果恒为 UNKNOWN —— 即使该行本身也是 NULL\n        if (literal == null) {\n            java.util.Arrays.fill(state, Tri.UNKNOWN);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) {\n            int lit = Column.toInt(literal);\n            int[] data = ic.raw();\n            switch (op) {\n                case \"=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] == lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"!=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] != lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] < lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \"<=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] <= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] > lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                case \">=\" -> {\n                    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                        int r = rows[off + i];\n                        state[i] = ic.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(data[r] >= lit);\n                    }\n                }\n                default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\"整型列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else if (c instanceof StringColumn sc) {\n            String lit = (String) literal;\n            if (op.equals(\"=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else if (op.equals(\"!=\")) {\n                for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                    int r = rows[off + i];\n                    state[i] = sc.isNull(r) ? Tri.UNKNOWN : tri(!lit.equals(sc.getString(r)));\n                }\n            } else {\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列不支持算子 \" + op);\n            }\n        } else {\n            throw new InvalidQueryException(\"不支持的列类型: \" + c.typeName());\n        }\n    }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":167,"oldLines":3,"newStart":167,"newLines":16,"lines":["             throw new InvalidQueryException(\"不支持的列类型: \" + c.typeName());","         }","     }","+","+    static String normalize(String op) {","+        return switch (op) {","+            case \"==\" -> \"=\";","+            case \"<>\" -> \"!=\";","+            default -> op;","+        };","+    }","+","+    private static byte tri(boolean b) {","+        return b ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;","+    }","+}"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"29eaadac-66a2-4811-8810-a466dfe1f953","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

{"parentUuid":"0f0679cb-b5da-4764-b13d-96c3a03cd14a","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_yd8qcnaqe94s19971as9r0yv","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/ProjectAggregate.java","content":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 投影 + 聚合执行器，直接消费 {@link SelectionVector}（稀疏 / 重复下标）。\n *\n * 正确性要点：\n *  - 只通过 Column.gather(rows) 按选择下标取值，绝不扫描整列，因此稀疏选择不会混入未选中行；\n *  - 每个下标处理一次，重复下标天然被重复投影 / 重复计入聚合（多重集语义）；\n *  - NULL 以位图为准，聚合忽略 NULL（count(*) 例外），空集 / 全 NULL 结果为 null；\n *  - 按 batchSize 对选择向量本身切批（而不是按源表行号），保证批边界独立于稀疏度。\n */\npublic final class ProjectAggregate {\n\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public ProjectAggregate(QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.plan = plan;\n        this.table = plan.table();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 投影 ----------------\n\n    /** 列式投影结果：保持请求列顺序；值数组与选择向量等长（含重复）。 */\n    public Map<String, List<Object>> project(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Map<String, List<Object>> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : plan.projection()) {\n            Column c = table.column(name);\n            cols.add(c);\n            out.put(name, new ArrayList<>(rows.length));\n        }\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            int[] chunk = new int[len];\n            System.arraycopy(rows, start, chunk, 0, len);\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) {\n                Object[] vals = cols.get(k).gather(chunk);\n                List<Object> sink = out.get(plan.projection().get(k));\n                for (Object v : vals) sink.add(v);\n            }\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 聚合 ----------------\n\n    /**\n     * 聚合入口。\n     * 无 groupBy：返回单行 Map（列名 -> 值）；\n     * 有 groupBy：返回 groups（有序，按组在选择向量中首次出现的顺序）与 groupColumns。\n     */\n    public AggResult aggregate(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (plan.groupBy().isEmpty()) {\n            return global(sv, stats);\n        }\n        return grouped(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult global(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Accumulator[] accs = buildAccumulators();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(rows, start, len);\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Accumulator a : accs) row.put(a.name, a.finish());\n        return AggResult.single(row);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult grouped(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        List<Column> groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy()) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, Accumulator[]> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"aa5b240e-cf3e-4954-b31c-8c801de662d6","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:48:22.531Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/ProjectAggregate.java","oldString":"    private static Object scalarValue(Column c, int row) {\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) return ic.getInt();\n        return ((StringColumn) c).getString(row);\n    }","newString":"    private static Object scalarValue(Column c, int row) {\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) return ic.getInt(row);\n        return ((StringColumn) c).getString(row);\n    }","originalFile":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 投影 + 聚合执行器，直接消费 {@link SelectionVector}（稀疏 / 重复下标）。\n *\n * 正确性要点：\n *  - 只通过 Column.gather(rows) 按选择下标取值，绝不扫描整列，因此稀疏选择不会混入未选中行；\n *  - 每个下标处理一次，重复下标天然被重复投影 / 重复计入聚合（多重集语义）；\n *  - NULL 以位图为准，聚合忽略 NULL（count(*) 例外），空集 / 全 NULL 结果为 null；\n *  - 按 batchSize 对选择向量本身切批（而不是按源表行号），保证批边界独立于稀疏度。\n */\npublic final class ProjectAggregate {\n\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public ProjectAggregate(QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.plan = plan;\n        this.table = plan.table();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 投影 ----------------\n\n    /** 列式投影结果：保持请求列顺序；值数组与选择向量等长（含重复）。 */\n    public Map<String, List<Object>> project(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Map<String, List<Object>> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : plan.projection()) {\n            Column c = table.column(name);\n            cols.add(c);\n            out.put(name, new ArrayList<>(rows.length));\n        }\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            int[] chunk = new int[len];\n            System.arraycopy(rows, start, chunk, 0, len);\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) {\n                Object[] vals = cols.get(k).gather(chunk);\n                List<Object> sink = out.get(plan.projection().get(k));\n                for (Object v : vals) sink.add(v);\n            }\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 聚合 ----------------\n\n    /**\n     * 聚合入口。\n     * 无 groupBy：返回单行 Map（列名 -> 值）；\n     * 有 groupBy：返回 groups（有序，按组在选择向量中首次出现的顺序）与 groupColumns。\n     */\n    public AggResult aggregate(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (plan.groupBy().isEmpty()) {\n            return global(sv, stats);\n        }\n        return grouped(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult global(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Accumulator[] accs = buildAccumulators();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(rows, start, len);\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Accumulator a : accs) row.put(a.name, a.finish());\n        return AggResult.single(row);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult grouped(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        List<Column> groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy()) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, Accumulator[]> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                int row = rows[start + i];\n                List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(groupCols.size());\n                for (Column c : groupCols) key.add(c.isNull(row) ? null : scalarValue(c, row));\n                Accumulator[] accs = groups.get(key);\n                if (accs == null) {\n                    accs = buildAccumulators();\n                    groups.add(List.copyOf(key), accs);\n                }\n                for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(new int[]{row}, 0, 1);\n            }\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n\n        // 输出\n        List<Map<String, Object>> outRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<List<Object>, Accumulator[]> e : groups.entrySet()) {\n            Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> key = e.getKey();\n            for (int k = 0; k < groupCols.size(); k++) {\n                r.put(plan.groupBy().get(k), key.get(k));\n            }\n            for (Accumulator a : e.getValue()) r.put(a.name, a.finish());\n            outRows.add(r);\n        }\n        return AggResult.grouped(plan.groupBy(), outRows);\n    }\n\n    private static Object scalarValue(Column c, int row) {\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) return ic.getInt();\n        return ((StringColumn) c).getString(row);\n    }\n\n    private Accumulator[] buildAccumulators() {\n        Accumulator[] accs = new Accumulator[plan.aggregates().size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < accs.length; i++) {\n            accs[i] = Accumulator.create(plan.aggregates().get(i), table);\n        }\n        return accs;\n    }\n\n    /** 聚合结果（两种形态之一）。 */\n    public static final class AggResult {\n        public final Map<String, Object> globalRow; null : (double) sum / count; }\n    }\n\n    // ---- min/max int ----\n    static final class MinInt extends Accumulator {\n        private final IntColumn col;\n        private int min = Integer.MAX_VALUE;\n        private boolean seen;\n        MinInt(String n, IntColumn c) { super(n); this.col = c; }\n        @Override void update(int[] rows, int off, int len) {\n            int[] data = col.raw();\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                int r = rows[off + i];\n                if (!col.isNull(r)) { seen = true; if (data[r] < min) min = data[r]; }\n            }\n        }\n        @Override Object finish() { return seen ? {"parentUuid":"cff5cdbe-09a6-445d-9305-d325707de613","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r6n4s7ay0zijlqjkl7943tvm","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/RowInterpreter.java","content":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 逐行解释器（参照实现 / differential oracle）。\n *\n * 与向量化引擎 {@link VectorFilter} 的实现刻意不同：\n *  - 一次只求一行的三值状态（无 byte[] 批次、无压实循环）；\n *  - 比较、IS NULL、AND/OR/NOT 全部走递归的标量求值；\n *  - 顶层 union 同样逐分支求值再做多重集合并（与向量引擎共用\n *    {@link SelectionVector#union}，保证合并算法一致、可比较）。\n *\n * 两个引擎过滤产出的选择向量必须逐下标相等，随后再用同一份 {@link ProjectAggregate}\n * 跑投影 / 聚合，结果必须逐位一致。\n */\npublic final class RowInterpreter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public RowInterpreter(Table table) {\n        this.table = table;\n    }\n\n    public SelectionVector apply(FilterExpr f, SelectionVector input, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = input.toArray();\n        if (f instanceof FilterExpr.Union u) {\n            SelectionVector merged = null;\n            for (FilterExpr branch : u.branches()) {\n                SelectionVector part = collect(branch, rows);\n                merged = (merged == null) ? part : SelectionVector.union(merged, part);\n            }\n            if (stats != null) stats.filterBatches += rows.length; // 逐行：每行一个“微批”\n            return merged == null ? SelectionVector.empty(table.rowCount()) : merged;\n        }\n        SelectionVector out = collect(f, rows);\n        if (stats != null) stats.filterBatches += rows.length;\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    private SelectionVector collect(FilterExpr f, int[] rows) {\n        List<Integer> hit = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (int row : rows) {\n            if (eval(f, row) == Tri.TRUE) hit.add(row);\n        }\n        int[] arr = new int[hit.size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = hit.get(i);\n        return SelectionVector.ofSorted(table.rowCount(), arr, arr.length);\n    }\n\n    /** 单行三值求值。 */\n    public byte eval(FilterExpr f, int row) {\n        switch (f) {\n            case FilterExpr.Compare cmp -> {\n                Column c = table.column(cmp.column());\n                if (cmp.value() == null) return Tri.UNKNOWN; // x = NULL / x != NULL 恒 UNKNOWN\n                if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) {\n                    if (ic.isNull(row)) return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n                    long v = ic.getInt(row);\n                    long lit = Column.toInt(cmp.value());\n                    return switch (VectorFilter.normalize(cmp.op())) {\n                        case \"=\" -> tri(v == lit);\n                        case \"!=\" -> tri(v != lit);\n                        case \"<\" -> tri(v < lit);\n                        case \"<=\" -> tri(v <= lit);\n                        case \">\" -> tri(v > lit);\n                        case \">=\" -> tri(v >= lit);\n                        default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\"整型列不支持算子 \" + cmp.op());\n                    };\n                } else {\n                    StringColumn sc = (StringColumn) c;\n                    if (sc.isNull(row)) return Tri.UNKNOWN;\n                    String v = sc.getString(row);\n                    String lit = (String) cmp.value();\n                    return switch (VectorFilter.normalize(cmp.op())) {\n                        case \"=\" -> tri(lit.equals(v));\n                        case \"!=\" -> tri(!lit.equals(v));\n                        default -> throw new InvalidQueryException(\"字符串列不支持算子 \" + cmp.op());\n                    };\n                }\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.IsNull isn -> {\n                boolean isNull = table.column(isn.column()).isNull(row);\n                return (isNull != isn.negate()) ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Not n -> {\n                return Tri.not(eval(n.child(), row));\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.And and -> {\n                byte state = Tri.TRUE;\n                for (FilterExpr ch : and.children()) state = Tri.and(state, eval(ch, row));\n                return state;\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Or or -> {\n                byte state = Tri.FALSE;\n                for (FilterExpr ch : or.children()) state = Tri.or(state, eval(ch, row));\n                return state;\n            }\n            case FilterExpr.Union u ->\n                throw new InvalidQueryException(\"union 只能位于根节点\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static byte tri(boolean b) {\n        return b ? Tri.TRUE : Tri.FALSE;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cb5f260b1e0ee2e88e8414ba","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1576,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":62264,"output_tokens":1430,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r6n4s7ay0zijlqjkl7943tvm":{"content":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 逐行解释器（参照实现 / differential oracle）。\n *\n * 与向量化引擎 {@link VectorFilter} 的实现刻意不同：\n *  - 一次只求一行的三值状态（无 byte[] 批次、无压实循环）；\n *  - 比较、IS NULL、AND/OR/NOT 全部走递归的标量求值；\n *  - 顶层 union 同样逐分支求值再做多重集合并（与向量引擎共用\n *    {@link SelectionVector#union}，保证合并算法一致、可比较）。\n *\n * 两个引擎过滤产出的选择向量必须逐下标相等，随后再用同一份 {@link ProjectAggregate}\n * 跑投影 / 聚合，结果必须逐位一致。\n */\npublic final class RowInterpreter {\n\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public RowInterpreter(Table table) {\n        this.table = table;\n    }\n\n    public SelectionVector apply(FilterExpr f, SelectionVector input, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = input.toArray();\n        if (f instanceof FilterExpr.Union u) {\n            SelectionVector merged = null;\n            for (FilterExpr branch : u.branches()) {\n                SelectionVector part = collect(branch, rows);\n                merged = (merged == null) ? part : SelectionVector.union(merged, part);\n            }\n            if (stats != null) stats.filterBatches += rows.length; // 逐行：每行一个“微批”\n            return merged == null ? RowInterpreter}（参照），\n * 并比较两者的选择向量、投影与聚合结果。不一致时抛 {@link EngineMismatchException}。\n */\npublic final class QueryEngine {\n\n    private final Catalog catalog;\n\n    public QueryEngine(Catalog catalog) {\n        this.catalog = catalog;\n    }\n\n    public Catalog catalog() {\n        return catalog;\n    }\n\n    public QueryResult execute(Object request) {\n        QueryPlan plan = new PlanBuilder(catalog).build(request);\n        return executePlan(plan);\n    }\n\n    public QueryResult executePlan(QueryPlan plan) {\n        // 向量化（被测）\n        ExecStats vs = new ExecStats();\n        EngineRun vector = runVector(plan, vs);\n\n        // 逐行参照\n        ExecStats rs = new ExecStats();\n        EngineRun reference = runReference(plan, rs);\n\n        // 差分比较\n        compare(vector, reference);\n\n        return new QueryResult(plan, vector, reference, vs, rs);\n    }\n\n    private EngineRun runVector(QueryPlan plan, ExecStats stats) {\n        SelectionVector input = plan.selection() != null\n                ? plan.selection()\n                : SelectionVector.lazyAll(plan.table().rowCount());\n        SelectionVector sv = input;\n        if (plan.filter() != null) {\n            sv = new VectorFilter(plan.table()).apply(plan.filter(), input, plan.batchSize(), stats);\n        }\n        return finish(plan, sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    private EngineRun runReference(QueryPlan plan, ExecStats stats) {\n        SelectionVector input = plan.selection() != null\n                ? plan.selection()\n                : SelectionVector.lazyAll(plan.table().rowCount());\n        SelectionVector sv = input;\n        if (plan.filter() != null) {\n            sv = new RowInterpreter(plan.table()).apply(plan.filter(), input, stats);\n        }\n        return finish(plan, sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    private EngineRun finish(QueryPlan plan, SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        ProjectAggregate pa = new ProjectAggregate(plan);\n        Map<String, List<Object>> projection =\n                plan.projection().isEmpty() ? null : pa.project(sv, stats);\n        ProjectAggregate.AggResult agg =\n                plan.hasAggregation() ? pa.aggregate(sv, stats) : null;\n        return new EngineRun(sv, projection, agg, stats);\n    }\n\n    private void compare(EngineRun a, EngineRun b) {\n        int[] sa = a.sv().toArray();\n        int[] sb = b.sv().toArray();\n        if (!java.util.Arrays.equals(sa, sb)) {\n            throw new EngineMismatchException(\"选择向量不一致：\\n  向量化 \"\n                    + java.util.Arrays.toString(sa) + \"\\n  逐行   \"\n                    + java.util.Arrays.toString(sb));\n        }\n        if (!Objects.equals(a.projection(), b.projection())) {\n            throw new EngineMismatchException(\"投影结果不一致：\\n  向量化 \"\n                    + Json.write(a.projection()) + \"\\n  逐行   \"\n                    + Json.write(b.projection()));\n        }\n        if (!aggEqual(a.agg(), b.agg())) {\n            throw new EngineMismatchException(\"聚合结果不一致：\\n  向量化 \"\n                    + Json.write(aggToJson(a.agg())) + \"\\n  逐行   \"\n                    + Json.write(aggToJson(b.agg())));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static boolean aggEqual(ProjectAggregate.AggResult a, ProjectAggregate.AggResult b) {\n        if (a == null || b == null) return a == b;\n        return Objects.equals(aggToJson(a), aggToJson(b));\n    }\n\n    static Map<String, Object> aggToJson(ProjectAggregate.AggResult agg) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        if (agg.globalRow != null) {\n            m.put(\"kind\", \"global\");\n            m.put(\"row\", agg.globalRow);\n        } else {\n            m.put(\"kind\", \"grouped\");\n            m.put(\"groupColumns\", agg.groupColumns);\n            m.put(\"rows\", agg.groupRows);\n        }\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    /** 单次引擎执行产物（内部）。 */\n    record EngineRun(SelectionVector sv,\n                     Map<String, List<Object>> projection,\n                     ProjectAggregate.AggResult agg,\n                     ExecStats stats) {}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c0f128aa1d179720996e0941","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1888,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":63288,"output_tokens":1472,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_vldv6al6m8ycp7zg5d5f0wxf":{"content":"package */\npublic final class QueryResult {\n\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final QueryEngine.EngineRun vector;\n    private final QueryEngine.EngineRun reference;\n    private final ExecStats vectorStats;\n    private final ExecStats referenceStats;\n\n    QueryResult(QueryPlan plan,\n                QueryEngine.EngineRun vector,\n                QueryEngine.EngineRun vector.sv(); }\n\n    /** 组装 /query 响应（同时也是 CLI 的输出内容）。 */\n    public Map<String, Object> toResponseJson() {\n        Map<String, Object> resp = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        resp.put(\"ok\", 投影（列式）\n        if (vector.projection() != null) {\n            Map<String, Object> proj = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            proj.put(\"format\", \"columnar\");\n            proj.put(\"rowCount\", new ArrayList<>(e.getValue()));\n            }\n            proj.put(\"columns\", cols);\n            resp.put(\"projection\", proj);\n        }\n\n        // 聚合\n        if (vector.agg() != null) {\n            resp.put(\"aggregates\", QueryEngine.aggToJson(vector.agg()));\n        }\n\n        // 计划（可导出的执行计划）\n        resp.put(\"plan\", plan.planToJson());\n\n        // 执行统计 + 与逐行参照一致性\n        Map<String, Object> exec = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        exec.put(\"vector\", statsJson(vectorStats));\n        exec.put(\"rowInterpreter\", statsJson(referenceStats));\n        exec.put(\"enginesAgree\", true);\n        resp.put(\"execution\", exec);\n        return resp;\n    }\n\n    private Map<String, Object> statsJson(ExecStats s) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"filterBatches\", s.filterBatches);\n        m.put(\"downstreamBatches\", s.downstreamBatches);\n        return m;\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c6800f4a48c37c2d9f6ed675","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1019,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":1270,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_23lkpuocvcx63jg0me1osv3r":{"content":"package java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 纯后端 JSON HTTP 入口（JDK 内置 {@link HttpServer}，不引入 Web 框架）。\n *\n * 路由：\n *   GET  /health         存活探针\n *   GET  /tables         列出目录中已注册的表\n *   POST /query          请求体为查询 JSON；200 返回结果，400 返回错误对象，500 内部错误\n *\n * 错误形态统一为 {\"ok\":false,\"error\":\"...\"}。\n */\npublic final class VecqServer {\n\n    private final QueryEngine engine;\n    private HttpServer server;\n\n    public VecqServer(QueryEngine engine) {\n        this.engine = engine;\n    }\n\n    public void start(int port) throws IOException {\n        server = HttpServer.create(new InetSocketAddress(port), 0);\n        server.createContext(\"/health\", this::health);\n        server.createContext(\"/tables\", this::tables);\n        server.createContext(\"/query\", this::query);\n        server.setExecutor(null);\n        server.start();\n    }\n\n    public int port() {\n        return server == null ? -1 : server.getAddress().getPort();\n    }\n\n    public void stop() {\n        if (server != null) server.stop(0);\n    }\n\n    private void health(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"ok\", true);\n        m.put(\"service\", \"vecq\");\n        writeJson(ex, 200, m);\n    }\n\n    private void tables(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"ok\", true);\n        java.util.List<Object> names = new java.util.ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<String, Table> e : engine.catalog().tables().entrySet()) {\n            Map<String, Object> t = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            t.put(\"name\", e.getKey());\n            t.put(\"rowCount\", e.getValue().rowCount());\n            t.put(\"columns\", e.getValue().columnNames());\n            names.add(t);\n        }\n        m.put(\"tables\", names);\n        writeJson(ex, 200, m);\n    }\n\n    private void query(HttpExchange ex) throws IOException {\n        try {\n            if (!\"POST\".equalsIgnoreCase(ex.getRequestMethod())) {\n                writeJson(ex, 405, error(\"只支持 POST /query\"));\n                return;\n            }\n            String body = new String(ex.getRequestBody().readAllBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n            if (body.isBlank()) {\n                writeJson(ex, 400, error(\"请求体为空，期望查询 JSON\"));\n                return;\n            }\n            Object parsed;\n            try {\n                parsed = Json.parse(body);\n            } catch (Json.JsonException e) {\n                writeJson(ex, 400, error(\"JSON 解析失败: \" + e.getMessage()));\n                return;\n            }\n            QueryResult result;\n            try {\n                result = engine.execute(parsed);\n            } catch (InvalidQueryException | InvalidSelectionException e) {\n                writeJson(ex, 400, error(e.getMessage()));\n                return;\n            }\n            Exporter.exportAll(result);\n            writeJson(ex, 200, result.toResponseJson());\n        } catch (Throwable t) {\n            writeJson(ex, 500, error(\"内部错误: \" + t.getClass().getSimpleName()\n                    + \": \" + t.getMessage()));\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static Map<String, Object> error(String msg) {\n        Map<String, Object> m = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        m.put(\"ok\", false);\n        m.put(\"error\", msg);\n        return m;\n    }\n\n    private static void writeJson(HttpExchange ex, int status, Object body) throws IOException {\n        byte[] bytes = Json.writePretty(body).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);\n        ex.getResponseHeaders().add(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json; charset=utf-8\");\n        ex.sendResponseHeaders(status, bytes.length);\n        try (OutputStream os = ex.getResponseBody()) {\n            os.write(bytes);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5a3d17270f7c9a5b809f00af","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2394,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":66360,"output_tokens":2584,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_aqlq2soqq3eda24q38xwn9d5":{"content":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.nio.file.Files;\nimport java.nio.file.Path;\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 命令行入口。\n *\n * 用法：\n *   vecq run <request.json | ->            执行一次查询（- 表示从标准输入读 JSON）\n *   vecq serve [--port N] [table.json ...] 启动 HTTP 服务，可预加载表文件到目录\n *\n * 退出码：0 成功；1 请求非法 / 查询失败；2 用法或 IO 错误。\n */\npublic final class Main {\n\n    public static void main(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length == 0) {\n            usage();\n            System.exit(2);\n        }\n        try {\n            switch (args[0]) {\n                case \"run\" -> run(args);\n                case \"serve\" -> serve(args);\n                case \"-h\", \"--help\", \"help\" -> {\n                    usage();\n                    System.exit(0);\n                }\n                default -> {\n                    System.err.println(\"未知命令: \" + args[0]);\n                    usage();\n                    System.exit(2);\n                }\n            }\n        } catch (SystemExit e) {\n            System.exit(e.code);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static void run(String[] args) {\n        if (args.length < 2) {\n            System.err.println(\"用法: vecq run <request.json | ->\");\n            throw new SystemExit(2);\n        }\n        String text;\n        try {\n            text = \"-\".equals(args[1])\n                    ? new String(System.in.readAllBytes(), java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets.UTF_8)\n                    : {"parentUuid":"c14e14fe-1e58-4b2c-9358-f56a041fc136","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"4a749c53-d240-4f6d-aeca-368c600b4392","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"call_q9mjormlrwt7wu9oo4frejey","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/ProjectAggregate.java has been updated successfully. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"1a5123e0-5f6a-435e-a24a-e89f103853d0","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:52:02.898Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/main/java/vecq/ProjectAggregate.java","oldString":"                    groups.add(List.copyOf(key), accs);","newString":"                    groups.put(List.copyOf(key), accs);","originalFile":"package vecq;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.LinkedHashMap;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 投影 + 聚合执行器，直接消费 {@link SelectionVector}（稀疏 / 重复下标）。\n *\n * 正确性要点：\n *  - 只通过 Column.gather(rows) 按选择下标取值，绝不扫描整列，因此稀疏选择不会混入未选中行；\n *  - 每个下标处理一次，重复下标天然被重复投影 / 重复计入聚合（多重集语义）；\n *  - NULL 以位图为准，聚合忽略 NULL（count(*) 例外），空集 / 全 NULL 结果为 null；\n *  - 按 batchSize 对选择向量本身切批（而不是按源表行号），保证批边界独立于稀疏度。\n */\npublic final class ProjectAggregate {\n\n    private final QueryPlan plan;\n    private final Table table;\n\n    public ProjectAggregate(QueryPlan plan) {\n        this.plan = plan;\n        this.table = plan.table();\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 投影 ----------------\n\n    /** 列式投影结果：保持请求列顺序；值数组与选择向量等长（含重复）。 */\n    public Map<String, List<Object>> project(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Map<String, List<Object>> out = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        List<Column> cols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String name : plan.projection()) {\n            Column c = table.column(name);\n            cols.add(c);\n            out.put(name, new ArrayList<>(rows.length));\n        }\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            int[] chunk = new int[len];\n            System.arraycopy(rows, start, chunk, 0, len);\n            for (int k = 0; k < cols.size(); k++) {\n                Object[] vals = cols.get(k).gather(chunk);\n                List<Object> sink = out.get(plan.projection().get(k));\n                for (Object v : vals) sink.add(v);\n            }\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        return out;\n    }\n\n    // ---------------- 聚合 ----------------\n\n    /**\n     * 聚合入口。\n     * 无 groupBy：返回单行 Map（列名 -> 值）；\n     * 有 groupBy：返回 groups（有序，按组在选择向量中首次出现的顺序）与 groupColumns。\n     */\n    public AggResult aggregate(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        if (plan.groupBy().isEmpty()) {\n            return global(sv, stats);\n        }\n        return grouped(sv, stats);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult global(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        Accumulator[] accs = buildAccumulators();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(rows, start, len);\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n        Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        for (Accumulator a : accs) row.put(a.name, a.finish());\n        return AggResult.single(row);\n    }\n\n    private AggResult grouped(SelectionVector sv, ExecStats stats) {\n        int[] rows = sv.toArray();\n        List<Column> groupCols = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (String g : plan.groupBy()) groupCols.add(table.column(g));\n\n        LinkedHashMap<List<Object>, Accumulator[]> groups = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n        int batches = 0;\n        for (int start = 0; start < rows.length; start += plan.batchSize()) {\n            batches++;\n            int len = Math.min(plan.batchSize(), rows.length - start);\n            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n                int row = rows[start + i];\n                List<Object> key = new ArrayList<>(groupCols.size());\n                for (Column c : groupCols) key.add(c.isNull(row) ? null : scalarValue(c, row));\n                Accumulator[] accs = groups.get(key);\n                if (accs == null) {\n                    accs = buildAccumulators();\n                    groups.add(List.copyOf(key), accs);\n                }\n                for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(new int[]{row}, 0, 1);\n            }\n        }\n        if (stats != null) stats.downstreamBatches += batches;\n\n        // 输出\n        List<Map<String, Object>> outRows = new ArrayList<>();\n        for (Map.Entry<List<Object>, Accumulator[]> e : groups.entrySet()) {\n            Map<String, Object> r = new LinkedHashMap<>();\n            List<Object> key = e.getKey();\n            for (int k = 0; k < groupCols.size(); k++) {\n                r.put(plan.groupBy().get(k), key.get(k));\n            }\n            for (Accumulator a : e.getValue()) r.put(a.name, a.finish());\n            outRows.add(r);\n        }\n        return AggResult.grouped(plan.groupBy(), outRows);\n    }\n\n    private static Object scalarValue(Column c, int row) {\n        if (c instanceof IntColumn ic) return ic.getInt(row);\n        return ((StringColumn) c).getString(row);\n    }\n\n    private Accumulator[] buildAccumulators() {\n        Accumulator[] accs = new Accumulator[plan.aggregates().size()];\n        for (int i = 0; i < accs.length; i++) {\n            accs[i] = Accumulator.create(plan.aggregates().get(i), table);\n        }\n        return accs;\n    }\n\n    /** 聚合结果（两种形态之一）。 */\n    public static final class AggResult {\n        public final Map<String, Object> globalRow;          // 非 null：全局聚合单行\n        public final List<String> groupColumns;              // 非 null：分组聚合\n        public final List<Map<String, Object>> groupRows;\n\n        private AggResult(Map<String, Object> g, List<String> gc, List<Map<String, Object>> gr) {\n            this.globalRow = g;\n            this.groupColumns = gc;\n            this.groupRows = gr;\n        }\n\n        static AggResult single(Map<String, Object> row) {\n            return new AggResult(row, null, null);\n        }\n\n        static AggResult grouped(List<String> gc, List<Map<String, Object>> rows) {\n            return new AggResult(null, gc, rows);\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":98,"oldLines":7,"newStart":98,"newLines":7,"lines":["                 Accumulator[] accs = groups.get(key);","                 if (accs == null) {","                     accs = buildAccumulators();","-                    groups.add(List.copyOf(key), accs);","+                    groups.put(List.copyOf(key), accs);","                 }","                 for (Accumulator a : accs) a.update(new int[]{row}, 0, 1);","             }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c14e14fe-1e58-4b2c-9358-f56a041fc136","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

{"parentUuid":"ea17067e-8fee-4543-b5ff-ad4f221c27b9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_16ltlofvc25bw64ehezw7otk","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/Assert.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.Json;\n\n/** 极简断言框架（无 JUnit 依赖）。 */\npublic final class Assert {\n\n    private Assert() {}\n\n    public static int passed = 0;\n    public static int failed = 0;\n\n    public static void that(boolean ok, String name) {\n        if (ok) { passed++; }\n        else { failed++; System.out.println(\"  [FAIL] \" + name); }\n    }\n\n    public static void eq(Object expected, Object actual, String name) {\n        // 通过 JSON 文本比较，消除 Integer/Long 等装箱差异\n        String e = Json.write(expected);\n        String a = Json.write(actual);\n        that(e.equals(a), name + \"（期望 \" + e + \"，实际 \" + a + \"）\");\n    }\n\n    public static void eqInt(int expected, int actual, String name) {\n        that(expected == actual, name + \"（期望 \" + expected + \"，实际 \" + actual + \"）\");\n    }\n\n    public static void eqDouble(double expected, double actual, String name) {\n        that(Double.compare(expected, actual) == 0,\n                name + \"（期望 \" + expected + \"，实际 \" + actual + \"）\");\n    }\n\n    public static void fails(Runnable r, Class<? extends Throwable> ex, String name) {\n        try {\n            r.run();\n        } catch (RuntimeException e) {\n            that(ex.isInstance(e), name + \"（期望异常 \" + ex.getSimpleName()\n                    + \"，实际 \" + e.getClass().getSimpleName() + \": \" + e.getMessage() + \"）\");\n            return;\n vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.InvalidSelectionException;\nimport vecq.SelectionVector;\n\nimport java.util.Arrays;\n\n/** 选择向量：惰性全选、显式构造、重复、越界、多集合并。 */\npublic final class SelectionVectorTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        SelectionVector lazy = SelectionVector.lazyAll(6);\n        Assert.that(lazy.isLazy(), \"lazyAll 初始为惰性\");\n        Assert.eqInt(6, lazy.size(), \"lazyAll 大小为行数\");\n        Assert.eq(Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), boxed(lazy.toArray()),\n                \"惰性全选物化后为 [0..n)\");\n        Assert.that(!lazy.isLazy(), \"toArray 后被物化\");\n\n        SelectionVector wrap = SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{5, 0, 2, 2});\n        Assert.eq(Arrays.asList(0, 2, 2, 5), boxed(wrap.toArray()),\n                \"显式下标排序且保留重复\");\n\n        SelectionVector sorted = SelectionVector.ofSorted(6, new int[]{1, 1, 4}, 3);\n        Assert.eq(Arrays.asList(1, 1, 4), boxed(sorted.toArray()), \"ofSorted 保留重复\");\n\n        Assert.fails(() -> SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{6}),\n                InvalidSelectionException.class, \"下标 == rowCount 越界被拒绝\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{-1}),\n                InvalidSelectionException.class, \"负下标被拒绝\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{1, 100}),\n                InvalidSelectionException.class, \"重复列表中夹带越界下标也被拒绝\");\n\n        // 多集合并：[0,2,2,5] U [1,2,5,5] = [0,1,2,2,2,5,5,5]\n        SelectionVector a = SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{5, 0, 2, 2});\n        SelectionVector b = SelectionVector.wrapSorted(6, new int[]{5, 1, 2, 5});\n        SelectionVector u = SelectionVector.union(a, b);\n        Assert.eq(Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2, 2, 2, 5, 5, 5), boxed(u.toArray()),\n                \"多集并集保留两侧重复次数并保持有序\");\n\n        // 与惰性全选合并\n        SelectionVector u2 = SelectionVector.union(SelectionVector.lazyAll(3),\n                SelectionVector.wrapSorted(3, new int[]{2}));\n        Assert.eq(Arrays.asList(0, 1, 2, 2), boxed(u2.toArray()),\n                \"惰性全选参与合并时先物化\");\n\n        SelectionVector empty = SelectionVector.empty(6);\n        Assert.eqInt(0, empty.size(), \"空选择向量大小为 0\");\n        Assert.eq(java.util.List.of(), boxed(empty.toArray()), \"空选择向量无下标\");\n    }\n\n    private static java.util.List<Integer> boxed(int[] arr) {\n        return Arrays.stream(arr).boxed().toList();\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c1d4dfb70141074fe8c6ed51","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2306,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":1797,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_75lrkmimrsgnslb7wyaczy9b":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"a761ec6c-f4f5-46d9-bcea-34ecea6c86f7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_u90lqfbafz3l3j6lwkm60z1u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/ColumnTableTest.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.Column;\nimport vecq.IntColumn;\nimport vecq.InvalidQueryException;\nimport vecq.Json;\nimport vecq.StringColumn;\nimport vecq.Table;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 列与表的构造、NULL 语义、长度一致性与 JSON 往返。 */\npublic final class ColumnTableTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Table t = Data.orders();\n        Assert.eqInt(6, t.rowCount(), \"orders 表 6 行\");\n        Column id = t.column(\"id\");\n        Assert.that(id instanceof IntColumn, \"id 是整型列\");\n        Assert.that(id.isNull(3) && !id.isNull(0), \"id 第 3 行 NULL，其余非 NULL\");\n\n        Column status = t.column(\"status\");\n        Assert.that(status instanceof StringColumn, \"status 是字符串列\");\n        Object[] gathered = status.gather(new int[]{0, 3, 3, 5});\n        Assert.eq(List.of(\"NEW\", null, null, \"NEW\"), List.of(gathered),\n                \"gather 命中 NULL 返回 null 且重复下标重复取值\");\n\n        // values 中显式 null\n        Object json = Json.parse(\"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,null,3]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\");\n        Table t2 = Table.fromJson(json);\n        Assert.that(t2.column(\"a\").isNull(1) && !t2.column(\"a\").isNull(0),\n                \"values 中的 null 等价于 NULL 位图声明\");\n\n        // nullRows 位图方式\n        Object json2 = Json.parse(\"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,2,3],\"nullRows\":[1]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\");\n        Table t3 = Table.fromJson(json2);\n        Assert.that(t3.column(\"a\").isNull(1), \"nullRows 位图方式判 NULL 正确\");\n\n        // 两种表达不一致应报错\n        String inconsistent = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,null,3],\"nullRows\":[0]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(inconsistent)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"values-null 与 nullRows 不一致被拒绝\");\n\n        // 列长度不一致\n        String ragged = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,2]},\n                  {\"name\":\"b\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"x\"]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(ragged)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"列长度不一致被拒绝\");\n\n        // 类型不匹配\n        String badType = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,\"oops\",3]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(badType)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"整型列中出现字符串被拒绝\");\n\n        // 表序列化为 JSON 后字段完整\n        Map<String, Object> exported = t.toJson();\n        Assert.eq(\"orders\", exported.get(\"name\"), \"导出表名\");\n        Assert.eqInt(6, ((Number) exported.get(\"rowCount\")).intValue(), \"导出 rowCount\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_c1d4dfb70141074fe8c6ed51","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2306,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":71480,"output_tokens":1797,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_u90lqfbafz3l3j6lwkm60z1u":{"content":"package
