java.util.Map;\n\n/** 列与表的构造、NULL 语义、长度一致性与 JSON 往返。 */\npublic final class ColumnTableTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Table t = Data.orders();\n        Assert.eqInt(6, t.rowCount(), \"orders 表 6 行\");\n        Column id = t.column(\"id\");\n        Assert.that(id instanceof IntColumn, \"id 是整型列\");\n        Assert.that(id.isNull(3) && !id.isNull(0), \"id 第 3 行 NULL，其余非 NULL\");\n\n        Column status = t.column(\"status\");\n        Assert.that(status instanceof StringColumn, \"status 是字符串列\");\n        Object[] gathered = status.gather(new int[]{0, 3, 3, 5});\n        Assert.eq(List.of(\"NEW\", null, null, \"NEW\"), List.of(gathered),\n                \"gather 命中 NULL 返回 null 且重复下标重复取值\");\n\n        // values 中显式 null\n        Object json = Json.parse(\"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,null,3]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\");\n        Table t2 = Table.fromJson(json);\n        Assert.that(t2.column(\"a\").isNull(1) && !t2.column(\"a\").isNull(0),\n                \"values 中的 null 等价于 NULL 位图声明\");\n\n        // nullRows 位图方式\n        Object json2 = Json.parse(\"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,2,3],\"nullRows\":[1]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\");\n        Table t3 = Table.fromJson(json2);\n        Assert.that(t3.column(\"a\").isNull(1), \"nullRows 位图方式判 NULL 正确\");\n\n        // 两种表达不一致应报错\n        String inconsistent = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,null,3],\"nullRows\":[0]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(inconsistent)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"values-null 与 nullRows 不一致被拒绝\");\n\n        // 列长度不一致\n        String ragged = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,2]},\n                  {\"name\":\"b\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"x\"]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(ragged)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"列长度不一致被拒绝\");\n\n        // 类型不匹配\n        String badType = \"\"\"\n                {\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n                  {\"name\":\"a\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,\"oops\",3]}\n                ]}\n                \"\"\";\n        Assert.fails(() -> Table.fromJson(Json.parse(badType)),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"整型列中出现字符串被拒绝\");\n\n        // 表序列化为 JSON 后字段完整\n        Map<String, Object> exported = t.toJson();\n        Assert.eq(\"orders\", exported.get(\"name\"), \"导出表名\");\n        Assert.eqInt(6, ((Number) exported.get(\"rowCount\")).intValue(), \"导出 rowCount\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"47ecb7c6-3630-4ec7-9698-38ddb8d6da28","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

Assert.eqInt(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.or(Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"FALSE OR UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.FALSE, Tri.or(Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE), \"FALSE OR FALSE = FALSE\");\n vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\n\n/**\n * 过滤测试：整型 / 字符串比较、IS [NOT] NULL、AND / OR / NOT、普通 OR 的去重语义、\n * 以及向量化引擎与逐行解释器结果一致（差分在 QueryEngine 内部已强制校验）。\n *\n * orders 表：id=[10,20,30,NULL,50,60]，status=[NEW,PAID,NEW,NULL,PAID,NEW]\n */\npublic final class FilterTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[10,20,30,null,50,60]},\n              {\"name\":\"status\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"NEW\",\"PAID\",\"NEW\",null,\"PAID\",\"NEW\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\";\n\n    private static String req(String filter, Integer batchSize) {\n        String bs = batchSize == null ? \"\" : (\",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + batchSize);\n        return \"{\" + TABLE + \",\" + filter + bs + \"}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 整型比较\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<\\\",\\\"value\\\":50}\", 4)),\n                \"id < 50 命中前 3 行（NULL 不命中）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(4, 5), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":50}\", 2)),\n                \"id >= 50 命中 4,5（batchSize=2 跨越 3 个批边界）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\", 1)),\n                \"id = 20（batchSize=1，每行一批）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"!=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\", 4)),\n                \"id != 20：NULL 行因 UNKNOWN 被排除\");\n\n        // 字符串比较\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"status = 'NEW'\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"!=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"status != 'NEW'：NULL 行被排除\");\n\n        // IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Assert.eq(List.of(3),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"id IS NULL\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"id IS NOT NULL\");\n\n        // AND / OR / NOT\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"and\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"<\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 2),\n                \"status=NEW AND id<50\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(2, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"or\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":30},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 3),\n                \"id=30 OR id=50（普通 OR 每行至多一次）\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1, 3, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"not\",\"child\":{\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"}}\n                        \"\"\", 4)),\n                \"NOT(status=NEW)：命中两个 PAID + NULL（NOT UNKNOWN=UNKNOWN 被排除？这里 NULL -> UNKNOWN）\"));\n\n        // 与 NULL 字面量比较恒 UNKNOWN -> 无命中\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":null}\", 4)),\n                \"id = NULL 不命中任何行（3VL）\");\n\n        // 无过滤 = 全选\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Q.rows(req(\"\", 4).replace(\",,\", \",\")),\n                \"无 filter 时全选（含 NULL 行）\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_431512108bc9863314a06ba5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2115,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":73528,"output_tokens":2002,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_so79l12ibgddrvc0nyx8rk3g":{"content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.Tri;\n\n/** 三值逻辑真值表（Kleene 逻辑）。 */\npublic final class TriTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.FALSE, Tri.not(Tri.TRUE), \"NOT TRUE = FALSE\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.TRUE, Tri.not(Tri.FALSE), \"NOT FALSE = TRUE\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.not(Tri.UNKNOWN), \"NOT UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN\");\n\n        // AND：任一 FALSE 即 FALSE；否则全 TRUE 才 TRUE，其余 UNKNOWN\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.FALSE, Tri.and(Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"FALSE AND UNKNOWN = FALSE\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.and(Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"TRUE AND UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.and(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"UNKNOWN AND UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.TRUE, Tri.and(Tri.TRUE, Tri.TRUE), \"TRUE AND TRUE = TRUE\");\n\n        // OR：任一 TRUE 即 TRUE；否则全 FALSE 才 FALSE，其余 UNKNOWN\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.TRUE, Tri.or(Tri.TRUE, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"TRUE OR UNKNOWN = TRUE\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.UNKNOWN, Tri.or(Tri.FALSE, Tri.UNKNOWN), \"FALSE OR UNKNOWN = UNKNOWN\");\n        Assert.eqInt(Tri.FALSE, Tri.or(Tri.FALSE, Tri.FALSE), \"FALSE OR FALSE = FALSE\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7a2f1bee-f3c7-4a58-af2d-834f92568e27","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

表：id=[10,20,30,NULL,50,60]，status=[NEW,PAID,NEW,NULL,PAID,NEW]\n */\npublic final class FilterTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[10,20,30,null,50,60]},\n              {\"name\":\"status\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"NEW\",\"PAID\",\"NEW\",null,\"PAID\",\"NEW\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\";\n\n    private static String req(String filter, Integer batchSize) {\n        String bs = batchSize == null ? \"\" : (\",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + batchSize);\n        return \"{\" + TABLE + \",\" + filter + bs + \"}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 整型比较\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<\\\",\\\"value\\\":50}\", 4)),\n                \"id < 50 命中前 3 行（NULL 不命中）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(4, 5), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":50}\", 2)),\n                \"id >= 50 命中 4,5（batchSize=2 跨越 3 个批边界）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1), Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\", 1)),\n                \"id = 20（batchSize=1，每行一批）\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"!=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\", 4)),\n                \"id != 20：NULL 行因 UNKNOWN 被排除\");\n\n        // 字符串比较\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"status = 'NEW'\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"!=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"status != 'NEW'：NULL 行被排除\");\n\n        // IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Assert.eq(List.of(3),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"id IS NULL\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"id IS NOT NULL\");\n\n        // AND / OR / NOT\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"and\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"<\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 2),\n                \"status=NEW AND id<50\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(2, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"or\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":30},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 3),\n                \"id=30 OR id=50（普通 OR 每行至多一次）\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1, 3, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"not\",\"child\":{\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"}}\n                        \"\"\", 4)),\n                \"NOT(status=NEW)：命中两个 PAID + NULL（NOT UNKNOWN=UNKNOWN 被排除？这里 NULL -> UNKNOWN）\"));\n\n        // 与 NULL 字面量比较恒 UNKNOWN -> 无命中\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":null}\", 4)),\n                \"id = NULL 不命中任何行（3VL）\");\n\n        // 无过滤 = 全选\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), Q.rows(req(\"\", 4).replace(\",,\", \",\")),\n                \"无 filter 时全选（含 NULL 行）\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"91e18ccb-0352-4118-a55b-732c622a7e85","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"!=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\", 4)),\n                \"id != 20：NULL 行因 UNKNOWN 被排除\");\n\n        // 字符串比较\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2, 5),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\", 4)),\n 4)),\n                \"status != 'NEW'：NULL 行被排除\");\n\n        // IS NULL / IS NOT NULL\n        Assert.eq(List.of(3),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}\", 4)),\n                \"id IS NULL\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 4, 5),\n           Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"and\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"<\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 2),\n                \"status=NEW AND id<50\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(2, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"or\",\"children\":[\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":30},\n                          {\"column\":\"id\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":50}\n                        ]}\"\"\", 3),\n                \"id=30 OR id=50（普通 OR 每行至多一次）\"));\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1, 3, 4),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\"\"\n                        \"filter\":{\"op\":\"not\",\"child\":{\"column\":\"status\",\"op\":\"=\",\"value\":\"NEW\"}}\n                        \"\"\", 4)),\n                \"NOT(status=NEW)：命中两个 PAID + NULL（NOT UNKNOWN=UNKNOWN 被排除？这里 NULL -> UNKNOWN）\"));\n\n        // 与 NULL 字面量比较恒 UNKNOWN -> 无命中\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n                Q.rows(req(\"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":null}\", 4)),\n                \"id = NULL 不命中任何行（3VL）\");\n\n        // 无过滤 = 全选\n {"parentUuid":"8ba8a492-d380-48e0-87e9-397ef85b27d5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_r4u294v69wcdhkvzy2bztzq6","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/BatchBoundaryTest.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 批边界测试：固定数据与过滤条件，遍历 batchSize = 1..n+2，\n * 结果必须逐下标一致，且实际过滤批数等于 ceil(输入行数 / batchSize)。\n */\npublic final class BatchBoundaryTest {\n\n    private static String tableDef(int n) {\n        StringBuilder vals = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) vals.append(',');\n            // 让命中行稀疏且与边界交错：仅偶数行命中，其中每隔 3 个偶数放一个 NULL\n            if (i % 2 == 0 && i % 6 != 0) vals.append(i);\n            else if (i % 2 == 0) vals.append(\"null\");\n            else vals.append(i); // 奇数行非 NULL 但谓词不命中\n        }\n        return \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"big\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\"\n                + vals + \"]}]}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        int n = 13; // 特意取质数，制造各种余数边界\n        List<Object> expected = List.of(2, 4, 8, 10); // 偶数、非 NULL：v=i 且 i%6!=0\n        String table = tableDef(n);\n\n        for (int bs = 1; bs <= n + 2; bs++) {\n            String req = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            // v=2 实际上只会命中行 2；改成偶数命中需要取模，引擎不支持 —— 用显式命中集重新断言：\n            // 直接断言与 bs 无关的稳定命中：v>=2 AND v<=10 AND v IS NOT NULL AND v!=? ——\n            // 简化：用 v>=2 AND v<=10 AND isNotNull 命中偶数与奇数混杂，\n            // 因此这里改为对每批跑同一条谓词，并与逐行参照（引擎内建差分）+ 期望值比较。\n            String req2 = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            Map<String, Object> resp = Q.resp(req2);\n            Assert.eq(List.of(2), resp.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时 v=2 始终只命中行 2\");\n            int expectedBatches = (n + bs - 1) / bs;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n            Assert.eqInt(expectedBatches, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时过滤批数为 ceil(\" + n + \"/\" + bs + \")=\" + expectedBatches);\n        }\n\n        // 稀疏命中下，同一条较宽谓词在所有批大小下结果稳定（与逐行引擎差分在引擎内完成）\n        String wide = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                + \"]}}\";\n        for (int bs : new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 13, 14, 100}) {\n            Assert.eq(expected, Q.rows(withBatch(wide, bs)),\n                    \"宽谓词在批大小 \" + bs + \" 下稳定命中 \" + expected);\n        }\n\n        // 空结果 + 大批次：批数仍为 1（输入非空时至少一批）\n        String none = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":99,\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":10000}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r = Q.resp(none);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), r.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"不可能命中的谓词产出空选择向量\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) r.get(\"execution\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(), \"空结果仍处理 1 个批次\");\n\n        // 空表：0 行 0 批\n        String empty = \"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"e\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[]}]}\"\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":0}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> er = Q.resp(empty);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), er.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"空表过滤结果为空\");\n    }\n\n    private static String withBatch(String req, int bs) {\n        return req.replace(\"\\\"filter\\\"\", \"\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs + \",\\\"filter\\\"\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_54f3fb981601037fce8e6023","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":864,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":77624,"output_tokens":1529,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_r4u294v69wcdhkvzy2bztzq6":{"content":"package {\n\n    private static String tableDef(int n) {\n        StringBuilder vals = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) vals.append(',');\n            // (int bs = 1; bs <= n + 2; bs++) {\n            String req = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            // v=2 实际上只会命中行 2；改成偶数命中需要取模，引擎不支持 —— 用显式命中集重新断言：\n            // 直接断言与 bs 无关的稳定命中：v>=2 AND v<=10 AND v IS NOT NULL AND v!=? ——\n            // 简化：用 v>=2 AND v<=10 AND isNotNull 命中偶数与奇数混杂，\n            // 因此这里改为对每批跑同一条谓词，并与逐行参照（引擎内建差分）+ 期望值比较。\n            String req2 = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            Map<String, Object> resp = Q.resp(req2);\n            Assert.eq(List.of(2), resp.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时 v=2 始终只命中行 2\");\n            int expectedBatches = (n + bs - 1) / bs;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n            Assert.eqInt(expectedBatches, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时过滤批数为 ceil(\" + n + \"/\" + bs + \")=\" + expectedBatches);\n        }\n\n        // 稀疏命中下，同一条较宽谓词在所有批大小下结果稳定（与逐行引擎差分在引擎内完成）\n        String wide = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                + \"]}}\";\n        for (int bs : new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 13, 14, 100}) {\n            Assert.eq(expected, Q.rows(withBatch(wide, bs)),\n                    \"宽谓词在批大小 \" + bs + \" 下稳定命中 \" + expected);\n        }\n\n        // 空结果 + 大批次：批数仍为 1（输入非空时至少一批）\n        String none = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":99,\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":10000}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r = Q.resp(none);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), r.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"不可能命中的谓词产出空选择向量\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) r.get(\"execution\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(), \"空结果仍处理 1 个批次\");\n\n        // 空表：0 行 0 批\n        String empty = \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":0}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> er = Q.resp(empty);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), er.get(\"selectedRows\"), vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 批边界测试：固定数据与过滤条件，遍历 batchSize = 1..n+2，\n * 结果必须逐下标一致，且实际过滤批数等于 ceil(输入行数 / batchSize)。\n *\n * 测试数据 v（13 行，质数长度制造各种余数边界）：\n *   偶数行 = NULL，奇数行 = 行号，即 [NULL,1,NULL,3,NULL,5,NULL,7,NULL,9,NULL,11,NULL]\n */\npublic final class BatchBoundaryTest {\n\n    private static final int N = 13;\n\n    private static String tableDef() {\n        StringBuilder vals = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) vals.append(',');\n            vals.append(i % 2 == 0 ? \"null\" : i);\n        }\n        return \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"big\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\"\n                + vals + \"]}]}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        String table = tableDef();\n        // v >= 2 AND v <= 10 AND v IS NOT NULL -> 行 3,5,7,9\n        List<Object> expected = List.of(3, 5, 7, 9);\n        String wide = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                + \"]}}\";\n\n        for (int bs = 1; bs <= N + 2; bs++) {\n            String req = withBatch(wide, bs);\n            Map<String, Object> resp = Q.resp(req);\n            Assert.eq(expected, resp.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 下命中行稳定为 \" + expected);\n            int expectedBatches = (N + bs - 1) / bs;\n            int actualBatches = vectorStat(resp, \"filterBatches\");\n            Assert.eqInt(expectedBatches, actualBatches,\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时过滤批数为 ceil(\" + N + \"/\" + bs + \")=\" + expectedBatches);\n        }\n\n        // 批次特别大（全部行落在同一批）\n        Map<String, Object> one = Q.resp(withBatch(wide, 100));\n        Assert.eq(expected, one.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"batchSize 远大于行数时单批处理\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, vectorStat(one, \"filterBatches\"), \"单批处理时 filterBatches=1\");\n\n        // 空结果但输入非空：仍处理 1 个批次\n        String none = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":99,\\\"filter\\\":\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":10000}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> nr = Q.resp(none);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), nr.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"不可能命中的谓词产出空选择向量\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, vectorStat(nr, \"filterBatches\"), \"空结果仍处理 1 个批次\");\n\n        // 空表：0 行 0 批\n        String empty = \"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"e\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":0}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> er = Q.resp(empty);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), er.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"空表过滤结果为空\");\n        Assert.eqInt(0, vectorStat(er, \"filterBatches\"), \"空表 0 个过滤批次\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    static int vectorStat(Map<String, Object> resp, String key) {\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        return ((Number) vec.get(key)).intValue();\n    }\n\n    private static String withBatch(String req, int bs) {\n        return req.replace(\"\\\"filter\\\"\", \"\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs + \",\\\"filter\\\"\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d591fd6286eb8ee544cd1ddd","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2428,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":77624,"output_tokens":2491,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_usue8lm4ehgkpzyumf1qgarn":{"content":"package ceil(输入行数 / batchSize)。\n */\npublic final class BatchBoundaryTest {\n\n    private static String tableDef(int n) {\n        StringBuilder vals = new StringBuilder();\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) vals.append(',');\n            // 让命中行稀疏且与边界交错：仅偶数行命中，其中每隔 3 个偶数放一个 NULL\n            if (i % 2 == 0 && i % 6 != 0) vals.append(i);\n            else if (i % 2 == 0) vals.append(\"null\");\n            else vals.append(i); // 奇数行非 NULL 但谓词不命中\n        }\n        return \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"big\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\"\n                + vals + \"]}]}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        int n = 13; // 特意取质数，制造各种余数边界\n        List<Object> expected = List.of(2, 4, 8, 10); // 偶数、非 NULL：v=i 且 i%6!=0\n        String table = tableDef(n);\n\n        for (int bs = 1; bs <= n + 2; bs++) {\n            String req = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            // v=2 实际上只会命中行 2；改成偶数命中需要取模，引擎不支持 —— 用显式命中集重新断言：\n            // 直接断言与 bs 无关的稳定命中：v>=2 AND v<=10 AND v IS NOT NULL AND v!=? ——\n            // 简化：用 v>=2 AND v<=10 AND isNotNull 命中偶数与奇数混杂，\n            // 因此这里改为对每批跑同一条谓词，并与逐行参照（引擎内建差分）+ 期望值比较。\n            String req2 = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2}\"\n                    + \"]}}\";\n            Map<String, Object> resp = Q.resp(req2);\n            Assert.eq(List.of(2), resp.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时 v=2 始终只命中行 2\");\n            int expectedBatches = (n + bs - 1) / bs;\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n            @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n            Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n            Assert.eqInt(expectedBatches, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(),\n                    \"批大小 \" + bs + \" 时过滤批数为 ceil(\" + n + \"/\" + bs + \")=\" + expectedBatches);\n        }\n\n        // 稀疏命中下，同一条较宽谓词在所有批大小下结果稳定（与逐行引擎差分在引擎内完成）\n        String wide = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":2},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":10}\"\n                + \"]}}\";\n        for (int bs : new int[]{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 13, 14, 100}) {\n            Assert.eq(expected, Q.rows(withBatch(wide, bs)),\n                    \"宽谓词在批大小 \" + bs + \" 下稳定命中 \" + expected);\n        }\n\n        // 空结果 + 大批次：批数仍为 1（输入非空时至少一批）\n        String none = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table + \",\\\"batchSize\\\":99,\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":10000}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> r = Q.resp(none);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), r.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"不可能命中的谓词产出空选择向量\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) r.get(\"execution\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, ((Number) vec.get(\"filterBatches\")).intValue(), \"空结果仍处理 1 个批次\");\n\n        // 空表：0 行 0 批\n        String empty = \"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"e\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[]}]}\"\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"v\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">\\\",\\\"value\\\":0}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> er = Q.resp(empty);\n        Assert.eq(List.of(), er.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"空表过滤结果为空\");\n    }\n\n    private static String withBatch(String req, int bs) {\n        return req.replace(\"\\\"filter\\\"\", \"\\\"batchSize\\\":\" + bs + \",\\\"filter\\\"\");\n count(*)=行数、count(col)=0、sum/avg/min/max=null；\n *  - 投影与分组中 NULL 正确透传。\n */\npublic final class AllNullColumnTest {\n\n    private static String table(int n) {\n        StringBuilder vals = new \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"an\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\" + vals + \"]},\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"note\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\" + vals + \"]}]}\";\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        String t = table(5);\n\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),\n                Q.rows(\"{\\\"table\\\":\" + t + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}}\"),\n                \"全 NULL 整型列 IS NULL 全命中\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n                Q.rows(\"{\\\"table\\\":\" + t + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNotNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"note\\\"}}\"),\n                \"全 NULL 字符串列 IS NOT NULL 无命中\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(),\n                Q.rows(\"{\\\"table\\\":\" + t + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"not\\\",\\\"child\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"}}}\"),\n                \"NOT(IS NULL) 在全 NULL 列上无命中\");\n\n        // 聚合\n        Map<String, Object> resp = Q.resp(\"{\\\"table\\\":\" + t + \",\\\"aggregates\\\":[\"\n                + \"\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"count(id)\\\",\\\"sum(id)\\\",\\\"avg(id)\\\",\\\"min(id)\\\",\\\"max(note)\\\"\"\n                + \"]}\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, 列分组：所有行属于同一个（NULL 键）组\n        Map<String, Object> grp = Q.resp(\"{\\\"table\\\":\" + t\n                + \",\\\"groupBy\\\":[\\\"note\\\"],\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"count(id)\\\"]}\")\n                .toResponseJson();\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> gagg = (Map<String, Object>) grp.get(\"aggregates\");\n        Assert.eq(\"grouped\", gagg.get(\"kind\"), \"分组聚合 kind=grouped\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = (List<Map<String, Object>>) gagg.get(\"rows\");\n        Assert.eqInt(1, rows.size(), \"全 NULL 分组列只产生一个组\");\n        AssertEq(rows.get(0), \"note\", null);\n ea.get(\"aggregates\");\n        Map<String, Object> erow = oneRow(eagg);\n        AssertEq(erow, \"count(*)\", 0L);\n        AssertEq(erow, \"sum(id)\", null);\n        AssertEq(erow, \"avg(id)\", null);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static Map<String, Object> oneRow(Map<String, Object> agg) {\n        return (Map<String, Object>) agg.get(\"row\");\n    }\n\n    private static void AssertEq(Map<String, Object> row, String key, Object expected) {\n        Assert.eq(expected, row.get(key), \"全 NULL 聚合 \" + key);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d591fd6286eb8ee544cd1ddd","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2428,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":77624,"output_tokens":2491,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_dduay7di1554l56fiafhxp09":{"content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 重复选择测试（核心验收项）：\n *  - 显式 selection 中允许重复下标；\n *  - 顶层 union 的多个分支命中同一行时产生重复下标；\n *  - 投影按多重集输出（重复行重复出现）；\n *  - 聚合按多重集累计（count 翻倍、sum 重复加）。\n */\npublic final class DuplicateSelectionTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[10,20,30]},\n              {\"name\":\"s\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\";\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 1) 显式重复 selection：[2,0,2] 排序为 [0,2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r1 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"selection\\\":[2,0,2],\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"s\\\"],\\\"batchSize\\\":2}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2, 2), r1.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"显式重复下标保留并排序\");\n        assertColumn(r1, \"id\", List.of(10, 30, 30), \"重复选择投影 id 出现两次 30\");\n        assertColumn(r1, \"s\", List.of(\"a\", \"c\", \"c\"), \"重复选择投影 s 出现两次 c\");\n\n        // 下游批数按选择向量长度计算（3 行，bs=2 -> 2 批）\n        assertDownstreamBatches(r1, 2, \"重复选择的下游批数按 SV 长度切\");\n\n        // 2) 过滤只保留重复源中的部分行：id>=20 -> [2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"selection\\\":[2,0,2],\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \",\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(2, 2), r2.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"过滤重复输入时重复输出\");\n        assertColumn(r2, \"id\", List.of(30, 30), \"投影仍为多重集\");\n\n        // 3) union：id<20 命中行0；id>10 命中行1,2；union => [0,1,2]\n        //    再让两分支都命中行2：分支A id<=30（0,1,2），分支B id>=20（1,2）=> [0,1,1,2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r3 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]},\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 1, 2, 2), r3.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                \"union 多集合并：行1、行2 各重复一次\");\n        assertColumn(r3, \"id\", List.of(10, 20, 20, 30, 30), \"union 投影多重集\");\n\n        // 4) union + 聚合：count(*) = 5；sum(id) = 10+20+20+30+30 = 110\n        Map<String, Object> r4 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]},\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"sum(id)\\\",\\\"avg(id)\\\",\\\"min(id)\\\",\\\"max(id)\\\"]}\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> aggRow = (Map<String, Object>)\n                ((Map<String, Object>) r4.get(\"aggregates\")).get(\"row\");\n        Assert.eq(5L, aggRow.get(\"count(*)\"), \"union 后 count(*) 按多重集计数\");\n        Assert.eq(110L, aggRow.get(\"sum(id)\"), \"union 后 sum 重复累加\");\n        Assert.eqDouble(22.0, ((Number) aggRow.get(\"avg(id)\")).doubleValue(),\n                \"union 后 avg = 110/5\");\n        Assert.eq(10, aggRow.get(\"min(id)\"), \"min 不受重复影响\");\n        Assert.eq(30, aggRow.get(\"max(id)\"), \"max 不受重复影响\");\n\n        // 5) 对照：同样两个谓词用普通 OR，每行只保留一次\n        Map<String, Object> r5 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"or\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]}}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2), r5.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                \"普通 OR 不去重语义：每行至多一次（与 union 形成对照）\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void assertColumn(Map<String, Object> resp, String col,\n                                     List<Object> expected, String name) {\n        Map<String, Object> proj = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"projection\");\n        Map<String, Object> cols = (Map<String, Object>) proj.get(\"columns\");\n        Assert.eq(expected, cols.get(col), name);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void assertDownstreamBatches(Map<String, Object> resp, int expected, String name) {\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        Assert.eqInt(expected, ((Number) vec.get(\"downstreamBatches\")).intValue(), name);\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6c178f90da9091d975d94fb8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2908,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":79672,"output_tokens":2854,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_kopjpc63j6208itbn06tuf7h":{"content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.InvalidQueryException;\nimport vecq.InvalidSelectionException;\n\n/**\n * 无效选择下标测试：\n *  - 显式 selection 中的越界 / 负下标必须在构造期被拒绝；\n *  - 计划层面的非法请求也必须被拒绝（列不存在、类型不匹配、非法算子、union 嵌套等）。\n */\npublic final class InvalidSelectionTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[1,2,3]},\n              {\"name\":\"s\",\"type\":\"string\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\".replace(\"\\\"string\\\":[\", \"\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\");\n\n    private static String sel(int... idx) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\");\n        sb.append(TABLE).append(\",\\\"selection\\\":[\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append(idx[i]);\n        }\n        return sb.append(\"]}\").toString();\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 越界下标\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(0, 3)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"下标 3（==行数）无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(99)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"下标 99 越界无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(-1)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"负下标无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(0, -2, 2)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"混合列表中的负下标无效\");\n\n        // 列不存在\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"nope\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":1}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"过滤引用不存在的列被拒绝\");\n\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"nope\\\"]}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"投影不存在的列被拒绝\");\n\n        // 类型不匹配\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"x\\\"}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"整型列与字符串比较被拒绝\");\n\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\\\"a\\\"]]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"a\\\"}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"字符串列使用 < 被拒绝\");\n\n        // 非法算子\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"~~\\\",\\\"value\\\":1}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"非法比较算子被拒绝\");\n\n        // sum 字符串列\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"s\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\\\"a\\\",\\\"b\\\"]]},\"\n                + \"\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"sum(s)\\\"]}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"sum 字符串列被拒绝\");\n\n        // union 嵌套\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":1}]}\"\n                + \"]}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"union 嵌在 and 内部被拒绝\");\n\n        // batchSize 非法\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"batchSize\\\":0}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"batchSize=0 被拒绝\");\n\n        // JSON 语法错误由 Json 层抛出（不是 InvalidQuery，单独覆盖）\n        Assert.fails(() -> vecq.Json.parse(\"{oops\"), vecq.Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"畸形 JSON 抛出 JsonException\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_6c178f90da9091d975d94fb8","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2908,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":79672,"output_tokens":2854,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_dk2gb0tgbb65ksn15ypvz4cp":{"content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 重复选择测试（核心验收项）：\n *  - 显式 selection 中允许重复下标；\n *  - 顶层 union 的多个分支命中同一行时产生重复下标；\n *  - 投影按多重集输出（重复行重复出现）；\n *  - 聚合按多重集累计（count 翻倍、sum 重复加）。\n */\npublic final class DuplicateSelectionTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"t\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[10,20,30]},\n              {\"name\":\"s\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\";\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 1) 显式重复 selection：[2,0,2] 排序为 [0,2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r1 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"selection\\\":[2,0,2],\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"s\\\"],\\\"batchSize\\\":2}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 2, 2), r1.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"显式重复下标保留并排序\");\n        assertColumn(r1, \"id\", List.of(10, 30, 30), \"重复选择投影 id 出现两次 30\");\n        assertColumn(r1, \"s\", List.of(\"a\", \"c\", \"c\"), \"重复选择投影 s 出现两次 c\");\n\n        // 下游批数按选择向量长度计算（3 行，bs=2 -> 2 批）\n        assertDownstreamBatches(r1, 2, \"重复选择的下游批数按 SV 长度切\");\n\n        // 2) 过滤只保留重复源中的部分行：id>=20 -> [2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r2 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"selection\\\":[2,0,2],\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \",\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(2, 2), r2.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"过滤重复输入时重复输出\");\n        assertColumn(r2, \"id\", List.of(30, 30), \"投影仍为多重集\");\n\n        // 3) union：id<20 命中行0；id>10 命中行1,2；union => [0,1,2]\n        //    再让两分支都命中行2：分支A id<=30（0,1,2），分支B id>=20（1,2）=> [0,1,1,2,2]\n        Map<String, Object> r3 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]},\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\"]}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 1, 2, 2), r3.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                \"union 多集合并：行1、行2 各重复一次\");\n        assertColumn(r3, \"id\", List.of(10, 20, 20, 30, 30), \"union 投影多重集\");\n\n        // 4) union + 聚合：count(*) = 5；sum(id) = 10+20+20+30+30 = 110\n        Map<String, Object> r4 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]},\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"sum(id)\\\",\\\"avg(id)\\\",\\\"min(id)\\\",\\\"max(id)\\\"]}\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> aggRow = (Map<String, Object>)\n                ((Map<String, Object>) r4.get(\"aggregates\")).get(\"row\");\n        Assert.eq(5L, aggRow.get(\"count(*)\"), \"union 后 count(*) 按多重集计数\");\n        Assert.eq(110L, aggRow.get(\"sum(id)\"), \"union 后 sum 重复累加\");\n        Assert.eqDouble(22.0, ((Number) aggRow.get(\"avg(id)\")).doubleValue(),\n                \"union 后 avg = 110/5\");\n        Assert.eq(10, aggRow.get(\"min(id)\"), \"min 不受重复影响\");\n        Assert.eq(30, aggRow.get(\"max(id)\"), \"max 不受重复影响\");\n\n        // 5) 对照：同样两个谓词用普通 OR，每行只保留一次\n        Map<String, Object> r5 = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"or\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"<=\\\",\\\"value\\\":30},\"\n                + \"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\">=\\\",\\\"value\\\":20}\"\n                + \"]}}\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(0, 1, 2), r5.get(\"selectedRows\"),\n                \"普通 OR 不去重语义：每行至多一次（与 union 形成对照）\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void assertColumn(Map<String, Object> resp, String col,\n                                     List<Object> expected, String name) {\n        Map<String, Object> proj = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"projection\");\n        Map<String, Object> cols = (Map<String, Object>) proj.get(\"columns\");\n        Assert.eq(expected, cols.get(col), name);\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void assertDownstreamBatches(Map<String, Object> resp, int expected, String name) {\n        Map<String, Object> exec = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"execution\");\n        Map<String, Object> vec = (Map<String, Object>) exec.get(\"vector\");\n        Assert.eqInt(expected, ((Number) vec.get(\"downstreamBatches\")).intValue(), name);\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"584056eb-4a0d-407a-8473-f37d5394bfc4","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}

{\"name\":\"s\",\"type\":\"string\":[\"a\",\"b\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\".replace(\"\\\"string\\\":[\", \"\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\");\n\n    private static String sel(int... idx) {\n        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(\"{\");\n        sb.append(TABLE).append(\",\\\"selection\\\":[\");\n        for (int i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {\n            if (i > 0) sb.append(',');\n            sb.append(idx[i]);\n        }\n        return sb.append(\"]}\").toString();\n    }\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 越界下标\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(0, 3)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"下标 3（==行数）无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(99)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"下标 99 越界无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(-1)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"负下标无效\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(sel(0, -2, 2)), InvalidSelectionException.class,\n                \"混合列表中的负下标无效\");\n\n        // 列不存在\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"nope\\\"]}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"投影不存在的列被拒绝\");\n\n        // 类型不匹配\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"x\\\"}}\"),\n                InvalidQueryException.class, \"整型列与字符串比较被拒绝\");\n\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                +                InvalidQueryException.class, \"字符串列使用 < 被拒绝\");\n\n        // 非法算子\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + InvalidQueryException.class, \"sum 字符串列被拒绝\");\n\n        // union 嵌套\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[1,2]}]},\"\n                + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"and\\\",\\\"children\\\":[\"\n                + InvalidQueryException.class, \"union 嵌在 and 内部被拒绝\");\n\n        // batchSize 非法\n        Assert.fails(() -> Q.run(\"{\\\"table\\\":{\\\"name\\\":\\\"t\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                +    // JSON 语法错误由 Json 层抛出（不是 InvalidQuery，单独覆盖）\n        Assert.fails(() -> vecq.Json.parse(\"{oops\"), vecq.Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"畸形 JSON 抛出 JsonException\");\n {"parentUuid":"654c4018-01b5-4eab-9ef4-3232da243d62","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_3tmcxd2f8nvfa2qgck8lybff","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/ProjectAggTest.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 投影与聚合综合测试：\n *  - 投影保持列顺序、NULL 透传、稀疏选择下不混入未选中行；\n *  - 全局聚合 / 分组聚合在过滤后子集上的结果；\n *  - count(*) 计数选择向量行数（含重复）。\n */\npublic final class ProjectAggTest {\n\n    private static final String TABLE = \"\"\"\n            \"table\":{\"name\":\"orders\",\"columns\":[\n              {\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[10,20,30,null,50,60]},\n              {\"name\":\"amt\",\"type\":\"int\",\"values\":[100,null,300,400,null,600]},\n              {\"name\":\"status\",\"type\":\"string\",\"values\":[\"NEW\",\"PAID\",\"NEW\",null,\"PAID\",\"NEW\"]}\n            ]}\"\"\";\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 投影：status='NEW' -> 行 0,2,5；投影 [id, amt, status]\n        Map<String, Object> r = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"NEW\\\"}\"\n                + \",\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"amt\\\",\\\"status\\\"],\\\"batchSize\\\":2}\");\n        assertCol(r, \"id\", List.of(10, 30, 60), \"投影 id\");\n        assertCol(r, \"amt\", List.of(100, 300, 600), \"投影 amt\");\n        assertCol(r, \"status\", List.of(\"NEW\", \"NEW\", \"NEW\"), \"投影 status\");\n\n        // 投影全选（含 NULL 行）：NULL 必须正确出现在列式结果中\n        Map<String, Object> all = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE + \",\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"amt\\\"]}\");\n        assertCol(all, \"id\", List.of(10, 20, 30, null, 50, 60), \"全选投影 id（含 null）\");\n        assertCol(all, \"amt\", List.of(100, null, 300, 400, null, 600),\n                \"全选投影 amt（含 null，null 与行 3 的非 null 400 不串位）\");\n\n        // 全局聚合：全表\n        Map<String, Object> agg = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"aggregates\\\":[\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"count\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"*\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"count\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"sum\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"avg\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"min\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"max\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"min\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\"},\"\n                + \"{\\\"func\\\":\\\"max\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\"}\"\n                + \"]}\");\n        Map<String, Object> row = globalRow(agg);\n        Assert.eq(6L, row.get(\"count(*)\"), \"count(*) = 6\");\n        Assert.eq(4L, row.get(\"count(amt)\"), \"count(amt) 忽略 2 个 NULL = 4\");\n        Assert.eq(1400L, row.get(\"sum(amt)\"), \"sum(amt)=100+300+400+600=1400\");\n        Assert.eqDouble(350.0, ((Number) row.get(\"avg(amt)\")).doubleValue(), \"avg(amt)=350.0\");\n        Assert.eq(100, row.get(\"min(amt)\"), \"min(amt)=100\");\n        Assert.eq(600, row.get(\"max(amt)\"), \"max(amt)=600\");\n        Assert.eq(\"NEW\", row.get(\"min(status)\"), \"min(status) 字典序 NEW\");\n        Assert.eq(\"PAID\", row.get(\"max(status)\"), \"max(status) 字典序 PAID\");\n\n        // 聚合作用于过滤后的子集：status='PAID' -> 行 1(amt NULL),4(amt NULL)\n        Map<String, Object> paid = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"column\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"=\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"PAID\\\"}\"\n                + \",\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"count(amt)\\\",\\\"sum(amt)\\\"]}\");\n        Map<String, Object> pr = globalRow(paid);\n        Assert.eq(2L, pr.get(\"count(*)\"), \"过滤后 count(*)=2\");\n        Assert.eq(0L, pr.get(\"count(amt)\"), \"PAID 行 amt 全 NULL -> count(amt)=0\");\n        Assert.eq(null, pr.get(\"sum(amt)\"), \"全 NULL 子集 sum=null\");\n\n        // 分组聚合：按 status（NULL 自成一组），按组键首次出现顺序 NEW,PAID,NULL\n        Map<String, Object> grp = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"groupBy\\\":[\\\"status\\\"],\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"sum(id)\\\"]}\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        Map<String, Object> gagg = (Map<String, Object>) grp.get(\"aggregates\");\n        Assert.eq(\"grouped\", gagg.get(\"kind\"), \"分组 kind\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(\"status\"), gagg.get(\"groupColumns\"), \"groupColumns\");\n        @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n        List<Map<String, Object>> grows = (List<Map<String, Object>>) gagg.get(\"rows\");\n        Assert.eqInt(3, grows.size(), \"3 个组（含 NULL 组）\");\n        Assert.eq(\"NEW\", grows.get(0).get(\"status\"), \"第一组 NEW\");\n        Assert.eq(3L, grows.get(0).get(\"count(*)\"), \"NEW 组 3 行\");\n        Assert.eq(100L, grows.get(0).get(\"sum(id)\"), \"NEW 组 sum(id)=10+30+60\");\n        Assert.eq(\"PAID\", grows.get(1).get(\"status\"), \"第二组 PAID\");\n        Assert.eq(70L, grows.get(1).get(\"sum(id)\"), \"PAID 组 sum(id)=20+50\");\n        Assert.eq(null, grows.get(2).get(\"status\"), \"第三组键为 NULL\");\n        Assert.eq(1L, grows.get(2).get(\"count(*)\"), \"NULL 组 1 行\");\n\n        // 聚合输出别名\n        Map<String, Object> aliased = Q.resp(\"{\" + TABLE\n                + \",\\\"aggregates\\\":[{\\\"func\\\":\\\"sum\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"amt\\\",\\\"alias\\\":\\\"total\\\"}]}\");\n        Assert.that(globalRow(aliased).containsKey(\"total\"), \"聚合别名 total 生效\");\n    }\n\n    @SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")\n    private static void assertCol(Map<String, Object> resp, String col,\n                                  List<Object> expected, String name) {\n        Map<String, Object> proj = (Map<String, Object>) resp.get(\"projection\");\n        Map<String, Object> cols = (Map<String, {"parentUuid":"6361adc0-9902-465d-ad2f-4365d31ef92d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_w3qj0hob2vnd4jp5ebazg55e","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/RandomDifferentialTest.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.FilterExpr;\nimport vecq.QueryResult;\nimport vecq.SelectionVector;\n\nimport java.util.ArrayList;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Random;\n\n/**\n * 随机差分测试（固定种子，可复现）：\n *  随机生成列数据（含随机 NULL）、随机深度的过滤表达式树、随机批大小与随机显式选择\n *  （含重复下标），引擎内部会强制比较向量化与逐行解释器；这里再对响应结构做断言。\n *\n *  两个引擎的过滤算法独立实现（字节数组批处理 vs 递归标量），\n *  任何批边界 / NULL / 三值逻辑分歧都会在这里以 EngineMismatchException 暴露。\n */\npublic final class RandomDifferentialTest {\n\n    private static final long SEED = 20260923L;\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Random rnd = new Random(SEED);\n        int rounds = 400;\n        for (int round = 0; round < rounds; round++) {\n            int n = 1 + rnd.nextInt(18);\n            int[] id = new int[n];\n            int[] nullId = new int[n];\n            int nc = 0;\n            StringBuilder idVals = new StringBuilder();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                if (i > 0) idVals.append(',');\n                if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 25) { nullId[nc++] = i; idVals.append(\"null\"); }\n                else { id[i] = rnd.nextInt(8); idVals.append(id[i]); }\n            }\n            String[] status = {\"NEW\", \"PAID\", \"X\"};\n            StringBuilder stVals = new StringBuilder();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                if (i > 0) stVals.append(',');\n                if (rnd.nextInt(100) < 25) stVals.append(\"null\");\n                else stVals.append('\"').append(status[rnd.nextInt(3)]).append('\"');\n            }\n\n            String table = \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"r\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\" + idVals + \"]},\"\n                    + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"status\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"string\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\" + stVals + \"]}]}\";\n\n            // 随机表达式树（深 0..3），只用普通 and/or/not/compare/isNull（union 单独测）\n            String filter = randomFilter(rnd, 3);\n            int bs = 1 + rnd.nextInt(Math.max(1, n + 2));\n\n            StringBuilder req = new StringBuilder(\"{\\\"table\\\":\").append(table)\n                    .append(\",\\\"batchSize\\\":\").append(bs)\n                    .append(\",\\\"filter\\\":\").append(filter);\n\n            // 40% 概率叠加含重复的显式 selection\n            boolean useSel = rnd.nextInt(100) < 40;\n            if (useSel) {\n                int k = rnd.nextInt(2 * n + 1);\n                StringBuilder sel = new StringBuilder(\"[\");\n                for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {\n                    if (i > 0) sel.append(',');\n                    sel.append(rnd.nextInt(n));\n                }\n                sel.append(']');\n                req.append(\",\\\"selection\\\":\").append(sel);\n            }\n            req.append(\",\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"id\\\",\\\"status\\\"],\\\"aggregates\\\":[\\\"count(*)\\\",\\\"sum(id)\\\"]}\");\n\n            QueryResult result;\n            try {\n                result = Q.run(req.toString());\n            } catch (Throwable t) {\n                throw new AssertionError(\"第 \" + round + \" 轮随机查询异常: \" + t.getMessage()\n                        + \"\\n请求: \" + req, t);\n            }\n            // selectedRows 必须是合法下标且有序\n            int[] sv = result.selectionVector().toArray();\n            int prev = -1;\n            for (int j : sv) {\n                if (j < 0 || j >= n) {\n                    throw new AssertionError(\"第 \" + round + \" 轮：选择向量出现越界下标 \" + j);\n                }\n                if (j < prev) {\n                    throw new AssertionError(\"第 \" + round + \" 轮：选择向量非有序\");\n                }\n                prev = j;\n            }\n        }\n        Assert.that(true, \"400 轮随机差分（向量化 vs 逐行）全部一致\");\n\n        // 随机 union（顶层多集合并）差分：引擎内校验向量与逐行一致\n        Random r2 = new Random(SEED ^ 0x9e3779b9L);\n        for (int round = 0; round < 100; round++) {\n            int n = 1 + r2.nextInt(12);\n            StringBuilder vals = new StringBuilder();\n            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {\n                if (i > 0) vals.append(',');\n                vals.append(i);\n            }\n            String table = \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"u\\\",\\\"columns\\\":[\"\n                    + \"{\\\"name\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"type\\\":\\\"int\\\",\\\"values\\\":[\" + vals + \"]}]}\";\n            List<String> branches = new ArrayList<>();\n            int bcount = 2 + r2.nextInt(3);\n            for (int b = 0; b < bcount; b++) {\n                branches.add(\"{\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\",\\\"op\\\":\\\"\"\n                        + (r2.nextBoolean() ? \"<=\" : \">=\")\n                        + \"\\\",\\\"value\\\":\" + r2.nextInt(n) + \"}\");\n            }\n            String req = \"{\\\"table\\\":\" + table\n                    + \",\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"union\\\",\\\"branches\\\":[\" + String.join(\",\", branches) + \"]},\"\n                    + vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.IntColumn;\nimport vecq.Json;\nimport vecq.NullBitmap;\nimport vecq.StringColumn;\nimport vecq.Table;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 手写 JSON 解析器 / 序列化器的往返与边界测试。 */\npublic final class JsonRoundTripTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 基本类型 + 顺序保留 + 嵌套\n        String s = \"{\\\"b\\\":true,\\\"n\\\":null,\\\"i\\\":-3,\\\"d\\\":1.25e2,\\\"s\\\":\\\"a\\\\nb\\\\t\\\\u0041\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"arr\\\":[1,2,[3]],\\\"o\\\":{\\\"x\\\":false}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> m = Json.asMap(Json.parse(s));\n        Assert.eq(Boolean.TRUE, m.get(\"b\"), \"true 解析\");\n        Assert.that(m.get(\"n\") == null, \"null 解析\");\n        Assert.eq(-3L, ((Number) m.get(\"i\")).longValue(), \"负整数解析\");\n        Assert.eqDouble(125.0, ((Number) m.get(\"d\")).doubleValue(), \"科学计数法解析\");\n        Assert.eq(\"a\\nb\\tA\", m.get(\"s\"), \"转义与 \\\\u0041 解析\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1L, 2L, List.of(3L)), m.get(\"arr\"), \"嵌套数组解析\");\n        Assert.eq(false, ((Map<?, ?>) m.get(\"o\")).get(\"x\"), \"嵌套对象解析\");\n\n        // 序列化往返\n        Object reparsed = Json.parse(Json.write(m));\n        Assert.eq(Json.write(m), Json.write(reparsed), \"紧凑序列化往返一致\");\n\n        // 表 JSON 往返\n        Table t = new Table(\"t\", List.of(\n                new IntColumn(\"id\", new int[]{1, 0, 3}, NullBitmap.fromNullRows(3, new int[]{1})),\n                new StringColumn(\"s\", new String[]{\"x\", null, \"z\"},\n                        NullBitmap.fromNullRows(3, new int[]{1}))));\n        Map<String, Object> exported = t.toJson();\n        Table back = Table.fromJson(Json.parse(Json.write(exported)));\n        Assert.eqInt(3, back.rowCount(), \"往返表行数\");\n        Assert.that(back.column(\"id\").isNull(1) && back.column(\"s\").isNull(1),\n                \"往返后 NULL 位图保留\");\n\n        // 错误 JSON\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\":}\"), Json.JsonException.class, \"缺值被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"[1,2,]\"), Json.JsonException.class, \"尾随逗号被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"\\\"unterminated\"), Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"未闭合字符串被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\":1} extra\"), Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"尾部多余字符被拒\");\n\n        // pretty 输出可再解析\n        Object prettyBack = Json.parse(Json.writePretty(m));\n        Assert.eq(Json.write(m), Json.write(prettyBack), \"pretty 输出可往返\");\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_59933de5f60f60b2f51e1e92","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":4062,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":85816,"output_tokens":2623,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_2ibubyrng27c9o75eh5rwkab":{"content":"package {"parentUuid":"0d8b4381-4ebd-437a-98f9-8a08095a2f04","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ax8npdny934h6aeeyj5ihagy","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a/src/test/java/vecq/test/ServerTest.java","content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.Catalog;\nimport vecq.Json;\nimport vecq.QueryEngine;\nimport vecq.Table;\nimport vecq.VecqServer;\n\nimport java.io.IOException;\nimport java.net.URI;\nimport java.net.http.HttpClient;\nimport java.net.http.HttpRequest;\nimport java.net.http.HttpResponse;\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/**\n * 真实启动 {@link VecqServer}（随机端口），通过 HTTP 走完整 JSON 链路：\n * /health、/tables、/query 成功、/query 400 错误形态。\n */\npublic final class ServerTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        Catalog catalog = new Catalog();\n        catalog.register(Data.orders());\n        VecqServer server = new VecqServer(new QueryEngine(catalog));\n        try {\n            server.start(0);\n            int port = server.port();\n            String base = \"http://localhost:\" + port;\n            HttpClient client = HttpClient.newHttpClient();\n\n            // health\n            HttpResponse<String> h = get(client, base + \"/health\");\n            Assert.eqInt(200, h.statusCode(), \"GET /health 200\");\n            Assert.eq(Boolean.TRUE, Json.asMap(Json.parse(h.body())).get(\"ok\"),\n                    \"/health ok=true\");\n\n            // tables\n            HttpResponse<String> tl = get(client, base + \"/tables\");\n            Map<String, Object> tablesResp = Json.asMap(Json.parse(tl.body()));\n            List<?> tables = (List<?>) tablesResp.get(\"tables\");\n            Assert.eqInt(1, tables.size(), \"目录中有 1 张表\");\n\n            // query：引用目录中的表名\n            String body = \"{\\\"table\\\":\\\"orders\\\",\\\"batchSize\\\":2,\"\n                    + \"\\\"filter\\\":{\\\"op\\\":\\\"isNull\\\",\\\"column\\\":\\\"id\\\"},\"\n                    + \"\\\"projection\\\":[\\\"status\\\"]}\";\n            HttpResponse<String> q = post(client, base + \"/query\", body);\n            Assert.eqInt(200, q.statusCode(), \"POST /query 200\");\n            Map<String, Object> qr = Json.asMap(Json.parse(q.body()));\n            Assert.eq(List.of(3), qr.get(\"selectedRows\"), \"HTTP 查询命中行 3\");\n            Assert.eq(Boolean.TRUE,\n                    ((Map<?, ?>) qr.get(\"execution\")).get(\"enginesAgree\"),\n                    \"HTTP 响应中双引擎一致\");\n\n            // 400：不存在的表\n            HttpResponse<String> badTable = post(client, base + \"/query\",\n                    \"{\\\"table\\\":\\\"nope\\\"}\");\n            Assert.eqInt(400, badTable.statusCode(), \"未知表 400\");\n            Assert.eq(Boolean.FALSE, Json.asMap(Json.parse(badTable.body())).get(\"ok\"),\n                    \"400 响应 ok=false\");\n\n            // 400：无效选择下标\n            HttpResponse<String> badSel = post(client, base + \"/query\",\n                    \"{\\\"table\\\":\\\"orders\\\",\\\"selection\\\":[42]}\");\n            Assert.eqInt(400, badSel.statusCode(), \"越界 selection 400\");\n\n            // 400：JSON 语法错误\n            HttpResponse<String> badJson = post(client, base + \"/query\", \"{not json\");\n            Assert.eqInt(400, badJson.statusCode(), \"畸形 JSON 400\");\n\n            // GET /query 405\n            HttpResponse<String> method = get(client, base + \"/query\");\n            Assert.eqInt(405, method.statusCode(), \"GET /query 405\");\n        } catch (IOException e) {\n            Assert.that(false, \"HTTP 测试 IO 异常: \" + e.getMessage());\n        } finally {\n            server.stop();\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static HttpResponse<String> get(HttpClient c, String url) throws IOException {\n        try {\n            return c.send(HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url)).GET().build(),\n                    HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new IOException(e);\n        }\n    }\n\n    private static HttpResponse<String> post(HttpClient c, String url, String body) throws IOException {\n        try {\n            return c.send(HttpRequest.newBuilder(URI.create(url))\n                            .header(\"Content-Type\", \"application/json\")\n                            .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(body)).build(),\n                    HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString());\n        } catch (InterruptedException e) {\n            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();\n            throw new IOException(e);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_59933de5f60f60b2f51e1e92","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":4062,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":85816,"output_tokens":2623,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_ax8npdny934h6aeeyj5ihagy":{"content":"package vecq.test;\n\nimport vecq.IntColumn;\nimport vecq.Json;\nimport vecq.NullBitmap;\nimport vecq.StringColumn;\nimport vecq.Table;\n\nimport java.util.List;\nimport java.util.Map;\n\n/** 手写 JSON 解析器 / 序列化器的往返与边界测试。 */\npublic final class JsonRoundTripTest {\n\n    public static void run() {\n        // 基本类型 + 顺序保留 + 嵌套\n        String s = \"{\\\"b\\\":true,\\\"n\\\":null,\\\"i\\\":-3,\\\"d\\\":1.25e2,\\\"s\\\":\\\"a\\\\nb\\\\t\\\\u0041\\\",\"\n                + \"\\\"arr\\\":[1,2,[3]],\\\"o\\\":{\\\"x\\\":false}}\";\n        Map<String, Object> m = Json.asMap(Json.parse(s));\n        Assert.eq(Boolean.TRUE, m.get(\"b\"), \"true 解析\");\n        Assert.that(m.get(\"n\") == null, \"null 解析\");\n        Assert.eq(-3L, ((Number) m.get(\"i\")).longValue(), \"负整数解析\");\n        Assert.eqDouble(125.0, ((Number) m.get(\"d\")).doubleValue(), \"科学计数法解析\");\n        Assert.eq(\"a\\nb\\tA\", m.get(\"s\"), \"转义与 \\\\u0041 解析\");\n        Assert.eq(List.of(1L, 2L, List.of(3L)), m.get(\"arr\"), \"嵌套数组解析\");\n        Assert.eq(false, ((Map<?, ?>) m.get(\"o\")).get(\"x\"), \"嵌套对象解析\");\n\n        // 序列化往返\n        Object reparsed = Json.parse(Json.write(m));\n        Assert.eq(Json.write(m), Json.write(reparsed), \"紧凑序列化往返一致\");\n\n        // 表 JSON 往返\n        Table t = new Table(\"t\", List.of(\n                new IntColumn(\"id\", new int[]{1, 0, 3}, NullBitmap.fromNullRows(3, new int[]{1})),\n                new StringColumn(\"s\", new String[]{\"x\", null, \"z\"},\n                        NullBitmap.fromNullRows(3, new int[]{1}))));\n        Map<String, Object> exported = t.toJson();\n        Table back = Table.fromJson(Json.parse(Json.write(exported)));\n        Assert.eqInt(3, back.rowCount(), \"往返表行数\");\n        Assert.that(back.column(\"id\").isNull(1) && back.column(\"s\").isNull(1),\n                \"往返后 NULL 位图保留\");\n\n        // 错误 JSON\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\":}\"), Json.JsonException.class, \"缺值被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"[1,2,]\"), Json.JsonException.class, \"尾随逗号被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"\\\"unterminated\"), Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"未闭合字符串被拒\");\n        Assert.fails(() -> Json.parse(\"{\\\"a\\\":1} extra\"), Json.JsonException.class,\n                \"尾部多余字符被拒\");\n\n        // pretty 输出可再解析\n        Object prettyBack = Json.parse(Json.writePretty(m));\n        Assert.eq(Json.write(m), Json.write(prettyBack), \"pretty 输出可往返\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0d8b4381-4ebd-437a-98f9-8a08095a2f04","session_id":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp16/a","sessionId":"7c76768a-49ee-4614-ae78-d6cf3d71222c","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp16-a","slug":"dreamy-waddling-muffin"}
